title: GNCore AI Engineering
description: Build LLM applications, retrieval and tool-using agents with grounded outputs and measurable task outcomes.

workflows.title: Evaluate an LLM Workflow
workflows.description: Measure an LLM feature with representative cases, explicit rubrics, failure analysis, and repeatable comparisons.
workflows.procedure: Define user tasks, failure severity, and acceptance thresholds before changing prompts or models. Build a representative, privacy-safe eval set; include edge cases and adversarial inputs. Use deterministic checks where possible and blinded human review for subjective quality. Track model/version, prompt, tools, latency, and cost. Do not present small or synthetic evals as proof of safety or broad reliability.

workflows.title: LLM Application Engineering
workflows.description: Implement reliable LLM features with structured outputs, bounded tools, privacy, and graceful failure handling.
workflows.procedure: Inspect provider APIs and existing architecture. Validate structured outputs, bound tool permissions and iteration, handle timeouts/rate limits, and provide a useful fallback. Minimize sensitive prompt data and avoid logging secrets. Ground claims in retrieved evidence when using RAG, cite provenance, and distinguish model output from verified facts. Never execute generated code or external actions without an explicit authorization path.

workflows.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation
workflows.description: Build a grounded retrieval workflow with traceable sources, chunking tests, and abstention on missing evidence.
workflows.procedure: Inspect corpus rights, freshness, access controls, and query patterns. Preserve source IDs and metadata through chunking and retrieval; enforce permissions before generation. Evaluate retrieval recall and answer grounding separately using representative questions. Cite retrieved sources and abstain when evidence is insufficient. Avoid indexing secrets or restricted content; make reindexing bounded and reversible.

workflows.title: Prompt Engineering
workflows.description: Improve prompts against explicit tasks and evaluations while preserving tool and safety boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Define desired behavior, failure modes, and a small representative evaluation set before editing. Make instructions concise, scoped, and testable; resolve conflicting priorities explicitly. Avoid brittle examples and hidden assumptions. Compare revisions on the same cases and include adversarial inputs. Never claim a prompt alone guarantees factuality, privacy, or safety.

workflows.title: Tool contracts and bounded agents
workflows.description: Tool contracts and bounded agents.
workflows.procedure: Validate tool arguments/results with explicit schemas, enforce caller authority and bound steps, time and cost. Separate reasoning from side-effect execution. Replay malformed tool outputs, injection attempts, tool timeouts and exhausted budgets against local fixtures.

workflows.title: Retrieval and grounding evaluation
workflows.description: Retrieval and grounding evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Evaluate retrieval recall/permission filtering independently from answer grounding. Keep source IDs through chunking, include unanswerable questions and inspect citations. Use the same corpus/query set for before/after comparison and avoid treating citation presence as proof of support.

title: GNCore Automation
description: Implement restartable developer automations with bounded inputs, retries and observable failure recovery.

workflows.title: Workflow Automation
workflows.description: Automate a repetitive workflow with bounded inputs, safe retries, idempotency, and clear human checkpoints.
workflows.procedure: Map triggers, inputs, side effects, failure modes and ownership before automating. Validate inputs, use least-privilege credentials, durable operation/payload identity and bounded idempotent retries. Preserve recoverable state and useful non-sensitive logs. Honor existing authorization; request review at an actual consequential boundary rather than repeatedly asking for already-authorized routine work. Test crash/replay on fixtures before claiming recovery or external execution.

quality_revision.reason: Use actual authorization boundaries and durable overlap/retry behavior.

workflows.title: Resume after partial execution
workflows.description: Resume after partial execution.
workflows.procedure: Record progress only after the operation's durable boundary and keep idempotency keys stable across retries. Inject failure after each meaningful side effect, resume against the same fixture and verify that no completed work is duplicated or silently skipped.

title: GNCore Cloud, DevOps and SRE
description: Build delivery pipelines, cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes and reliable service operations.

workflows.title: Cloud Architecture
workflows.description: Design a cloud deployment around explicit reliability, security, operations, and cost constraints.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current provider, workload, data classification, traffic, recovery targets, team skills, and budget. Prefer managed services only when their operational and cost tradeoffs fit. Define trust boundaries, failure modes, backup/restore, and observability. Do not create resources or expose endpoints without authorization. Mark estimates and assumptions; avoid claiming compliance without evidence.

workflows.title: Cloud Cost Optimization
workflows.description: Find measurable cloud cost reductions while protecting reliability and workload correctness.
workflows.procedure: Use billing and utilization evidence with a stated period and scope. Separate idle waste, rightsizing, storage lifecycle, and architecture changes. Estimate savings and service risk; identify reversibility and validation. Avoid deleting resources, reducing capacity, or purchasing commitments without approval. Measure after a change and retain rollback options.

workflows.title: Cloud Architecture Review
workflows.description: Compare cloud designs against workload, reliability, security, cost, and operational constraints.
workflows.procedure: Clarify workload and provider, data classification, traffic, recovery targets, team skills, and budget. Trace failure domains, IAM, data movement, backup/restore, observability, and cost; mark assumptions.

workflows.title: Infrastructure as Code
workflows.description: Author or review infrastructure changes with plan inspection, least privilege, and rollback.
workflows.procedure: Use existing modules and provider versions, isolate environments, validate state and drift, inspect the generated plan, and protect secrets. Do not apply or destroy live infrastructure without explicit approval.

workflows.title: CI/CD Pipeline
workflows.description: Improve a delivery pipeline with reproducibility, least privilege, useful gates, and rollback.
workflows.procedure: Trace build provenance, secrets, permissions, test stages, artifact promotion, deployment strategy, and recovery. Verify the pipeline on a safe branch or environment and preserve protected release checks.

workflows.title: Container Build and Hardening
workflows.description: Build a reproducible container with a minimal attack surface and reliable runtime behavior.
workflows.procedure: Inspect runtime and platform needs; minimize base and copied files, run non-root, pin controlled inputs, exclude secrets, scan outputs, and test health/shutdown behavior. Do not publish images without permission.

workflows.title: Kubernetes Workload Review
workflows.description: Review Kubernetes workloads for availability, resource bounds, identity, health, and rollout safety.
workflows.procedure: Check probes, requests/limits, replicas, disruption, security context, service-account scope, network exposure, rollout and rollback. Validate rendered manifests and never apply to a live cluster without approval.

workflows.title: SLO and Error Budget
workflows.description: Define service-level indicators and objectives that reflect user-visible reliability.
workflows.procedure: Choose user-centric good/total events, window, target, exclusions, and data source. Validate measurement and alerting; use error budgets to guide decisions without hiding user impact.

workflows.title: Service Observability
workflows.description: Instrument service behavior with actionable metrics, structured logs, and traces.
workflows.procedure: Start from user failure modes, define low-cardinality signals, preserve trace context, exclude secrets and personal data, and set sampling/retention. Verify telemetry against a known request and cost.

workflows.title: SRE Incident Management
workflows.description: Manage a reliability incident through impact assessment, safe mitigation, verification, and learning.
workflows.procedure: Set incident roles and timeline, assess user impact, state mitigation hypothesis, preserve evidence, and verify recovery against SLO signals. Record root-cause contributors without blame and track corrective work.

workflows.title: Capacity and Load Plan
workflows.description: Plan service capacity using measured demand, bottleneck data, growth uncertainty, and failure headroom.
workflows.procedure: Profile representative workload, identify saturation point and dependencies, model peak and failure scenarios, and define scaling thresholds. Avoid changes based only on average utilization.

workflows.title: Cloud Cost Optimization
workflows.description: Reduce measurable infrastructure spend while protecting service objectives and recovery options.
workflows.procedure: Use dated billing and utilization evidence, classify waste versus required headroom, estimate savings and risk, and test reversible changes. Do not delete, downsize, or purchase commitments without approval.

workflows.title: DevOps Engineering
workflows.description: Improve build and delivery workflows with reproducible steps, safe rollout, and actionable failure signals.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current pipeline, environments, secrets, and rollback process. Make steps deterministic, least-privileged, and observable; cache only safe artifacts. Validate configuration and test a non-production path first. Do not deploy, rotate secrets, destroy resources, or change production workflows without explicit authorization. Report required credentials as names only, never values.

workflows.title: Kubernetes Engineering
workflows.description: Author Kubernetes resources with least privilege, clear health behavior, and safe rollout settings.
workflows.procedure: Inspect cluster version, namespace, chart conventions, workload needs, and security policies. Set resource requests/limits, probes that reflect readiness, least-privilege service accounts, and safe rollout/rollback behavior. Keep secrets out of manifests. Validate manifests locally; do not apply to a live cluster or expose services publicly without explicit authorization.

workflows.title: Incident Response
workflows.description: Triage incidents from evidence, reduce impact safely, and preserve a clear timeline and follow-up.
workflows.procedure: Establish impact, timeline, scope, and current signals from available evidence. Prioritize reversible mitigations and state expected effects before action. Preserve logs and avoid destructive cleanup or speculative changes. Separate facts from hypotheses, assign verification steps, and document recovery criteria and follow-ups. Do not perform live production actions unless explicitly authorized.

title: GNCore Software Engineering
description: Implement, diagnose, review and refactor software across languages while preserving public behavior.

workflows.title: GNCore Grill Me
workflows.description: Clarify a coding or product request through focused questions that expose assumptions and missing decisions.
workflows.procedure: Identify decisions that materially change scope, contracts or feasibility and ask a short prioritized set of questions. Use repository evidence to answer routine choices yourself. Record settled decisions, assumptions and actual blockers without turning the task into an unbounded interview.

workflows.title: GNCore Research
workflows.description: Investigate a technical question using repository evidence and relevant primary sources.
workflows.procedure: Search code, call sites, installed versions and primary documentation for the concrete technical question. Reproduce the uncertain behavior in a small fixture when possible and separate observations from inference. Deliver a cited recommendation with compatibility limits rather than a generic technology list.

workflows.title: GNCore Prototype
workflows.description: Build a scoped prototype that tests a specific technical or product assumption.
workflows.procedure: Choose the single assumption the prototype should test and define an observable result. Build the smallest executable vertical slice with clearly marked simulated boundaries. Record what the experiment establishes, what remains untested and which prototype shortcuts must change before production use.

workflows.title: GNCore Domain Modeling
workflows.description: Model domain concepts, invariants, ownership, and language before changing service boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Extract entities, values, invariants, lifecycle transitions and ownership from actual examples. Test shared vocabulary against awkward cases and identify bounded contexts before assigning service boundaries. Produce a model that clarifies code decisions, not a diagram detached from behavior.

workflows.title: GNCore Decision Mapping
workflows.description: Map unresolved implementation decisions, dependencies, options, and evidence needed to choose.
workflows.procedure: List decisions that materially affect the requested outcome. For each, record options, constraints, dependencies, reversibility, owner, and the evidence needed to choose. Resolve choices already implied by repository conventions; ask about only decisions that affect scope or correctness. Deliver a decision map and a concrete next implementation step, without treating every preference as a blocker.

workflows.title: GNCore Search First
workflows.description: Search the existing codebase and relevant documentation before adding dependencies or implementing duplicate functionality.
workflows.procedure: Inspect repository symbols, dependencies and existing utilities before adding a new implementation. Compare the closest existing path against the needed contract and reuse or extend it when it fits. Record the concrete gap if new code or a dependency is justified.

workflows.title: GNCore Product Lens
workflows.description: Validate the why before building through four product diagnostics — a YC-style product diagnostic that produces PRODUCT-BRIEF.md with a go/no-go recommendation, a founder review scoring product-market-fit signals, a user journey audit measuring time-to-value, and ICE feature prioritization.
workflows.procedure: Connect the proposed feature to a specific user problem, current workaround and measurable outcome. Use supplied evidence and identify the cheapest useful uncertainty test. Keep product assumptions explicit without replacing the user's authorized implementation task with an unsolicited strategy exercise.

workflows.title: GNCore Architecture Decision Records
workflows.description: Capture architectural decisions as numbered ADR markdown files in docs/adr/ with context, alternatives considered, consequences, and an index README.
workflows.procedure: Capture the concrete decision, constraints, viable alternatives and consequences with links to code or evidence. State the chosen boundary and reversal/migration cost. Follow the repository's ADR numbering/index conventions and avoid recording routine implementation trivia as architecture policy.

workflows.title: GNCore Blueprint
workflows.description: Plan a substantial engineering change as reviewable steps with dependencies and acceptance evidence.
workflows.procedure: Split a substantial change into reviewable outcomes with dependencies, acceptance evidence and enough call-path/context information to resume later. Sequence uncertain boundaries early and keep the plan mutable as evidence changes. Do not assume delegation, universal approval gates or a new project structure.

workflows.title: GNCore Architecture
workflows.description: Shared vocabulary for designing deep modules.
workflows.procedure: Map public behavior, module boundaries and the information each module hides. Propose a smaller stable interface for a concrete change and compare call-site complexity before/after. Document the tradeoff and verify contracts rather than adding abstract layers for their own sake.

workflows.title: GNCore Improve Architecture
workflows.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.
workflows.procedure: Find a specific coupling or shallow-module problem in current call paths. Choose a bounded deepening/refactor, preserve behavior with representative regressions and migrate callers in a reviewable sequence. Explain the reduced change surface with concrete before/after examples.

workflows.title: GNCore Quality
workflows.description: Baseline cross-project coding conventions for naming, readability, immutability, and code-quality review.
workflows.procedure: Review the changed code against local naming, error handling, API clarity and maintainability conventions. Prioritize defects or complexity with concrete consequences and preserve behavior while improving it. Run the relevant formatter/type/lint/tests without weakening their rules to make the diff pass.

workflows.title: GNCore Codebase Onboarding
workflows.description: Analyze an unfamiliar codebase and generate a structured onboarding guide with architecture map, key entry points, conventions, and a starter CLAUDE.md.
workflows.procedure: Trace entrypoints, important data/control paths, build/test commands and extension boundaries in the current revision. Produce a concise evidence-linked map and a verified starter task. Do not silently install hooks or rewrite the host agent's configuration as part of learning the codebase.

workflows.title: GNCore Plankton Code Quality
workflows.description: Write-time code quality enforcement using Plankton — auto-formatting, linting, and Claude-powered fixes on every file edit via hooks.
workflows.procedure: Use Plankton only if the project requests or already configures it; inspect its actual executable and supported settings. Diagnose formatter/linter or hook failures at the configured boundary and verify their effect on a fixture. Do not assume a Claude-specific hook exists in another host.

workflows.title: GNCore Code Review
workflows.description: Review a code diff for correctness, local coding standards, and alignment with its originating specification.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the complete changed behavior and relevant callers/specification. Report actionable correctness, compatibility, security or performance findings with file/line evidence and a failure scenario. Separate definite defects from questions and style preferences; do not invent findings to fill a quota.

workflows.title: GNCore Request Refactor Plan
workflows.description: Plan a behavior-preserving refactor with explicit scope, sequencing, and regression checks.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the current implementation, callers, and regression coverage. State the concrete maintainability problem and the observable behaviors that must remain unchanged. Propose a sequence of small changes with touched modules, compatibility boundaries, and checks for each step. Flag data migrations or API breaks explicitly. Deliver the requested plan; implement it only when implementation is within the user's request.

workflows.title: GNCore Code Improver
workflows.description: Run a bounded review-and-fix loop over a specified code target with evidence and scope controls.
workflows.procedure: Bound the review target and define which checks establish correct behavior. Fix the highest-impact observed issue, rerun relevant checks and inspect the resulting diff. Stop when acceptance is met or unchanged failures need new evidence; do not repeatedly rewrite clean code for cosmetic variety.

workflows.title: GNCore Code Maturity Assessor
workflows.description: Systematic code maturity assessment using Trail of Bits' 9-category framework.
workflows.procedure: Evaluate the supplied repository against explicit dimensions such as correctness evidence, operational ownership, dependency hygiene and maintainability. Cite observable evidence and missing evidence for each assessment. Do not equate a numerical rubric score with certification or compare incompatible project scopes.

workflows.title: GNCore Tdd
workflows.description: Implement a behavior change through meaningful failing tests, a focused fix, and relevant regressions.
workflows.procedure: Write a behavioral regression that fails for the intended reason, implement the smallest contract-correct change and refactor after green. Cover an important boundary beyond the initial happy path. Use TDD where it clarifies behavior rather than adding mirror tests for trivial reversible edits.

workflows.title: GNCore Tdd Workflow
workflows.description: Use a focused red/green/refactor loop around an observable behavior contract.
workflows.procedure: Plan the test boundary and fixtures before changing behavior. Keep a red/green/refactor loop around user-visible contracts and integration risks, with deterministic cleanup. Choose coverage based on meaningful failure paths rather than enforcing an arbitrary percentage as proof of quality.

workflows.title: GNCore E2E Testing
workflows.description: Playwright E2E testing patterns, Page Object Model, configuration, CI/CD integration, artifact management, and flaky test strategies.
workflows.procedure: Select a critical user journey, deterministic setup and isolated test identity. Assert visible state through accessible selectors, wait for conditions and clean up side effects. Capture browser/environment evidence and error paths; avoid fixed sleeps and assertions coupled only to CSS classes.

workflows.title: GNCore Ai Regression Testing
workflows.description: Regression testing strategies for AI-assisted development.
workflows.procedure: Version representative prompts, tool fixtures and expected observable outcomes before changing model-assisted behavior. Compare constraint compliance and task completion on the same inputs, preserving failure traces. Separate nondeterministic semantic review from deterministic schema/tool checks.

workflows.title: GNCore Module Regression
workflows.description: Govern cross-module regression in large repositories with a REGRESSION.md ledger that records each module's downstream consumers and executable acceptance command.
workflows.procedure: Map the changed module's downstream consumers and public contracts. Add targeted regressions at the affected boundary and run representative consumer checks; retain an acceptance-command ledger only when it helps the repository. Do not assume every module needs the same end-to-end suite.

workflows.title: GNCore Property Based Testing
workflows.description: Writes, reviews, and debugs property-based tests — Hypothesis, fast-check, proptest, jqwik, rapid, and Echidna or Medusa for Solidity invariants.
workflows.procedure: State an invariant independent of the implementation and define valid generators plus invalid boundaries. Compare against a simple oracle or metamorphic relation and retain minimized counterexamples. Avoid generators that exclude the failure class or properties that merely restate the code.

workflows.title: GNCore Coverage Analysis
workflows.description: Measures and interprets what a fuzzing campaign actually reaches, using llvm-cov, lcov, or a fuzzer's own coverage output.
workflows.procedure: Use coverage to find unexercised branches relevant to the change, then inspect their failure impact. Add meaningful inputs/assertions for important gaps and explain remaining exclusions. A high line percentage is not evidence that assertions detect defects.

workflows.title: GNCore Debugging
workflows.description: Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes
workflows.procedure: Reproduce the failure and trace the responsible state/data transition before editing. Form a specific hypothesis, use the smallest discriminating probe and fix the confirmed cause. Keep the original reproduction and a boundary regression to demonstrate the problem is resolved.

workflows.title: GNCore Verification Before Completion
workflows.description: Verify the requested software outcome with fresh command output before reporting completion.
workflows.procedure: Match each completion claim to an actually run command, observed artifact or explicit unavailable check. Re-run affected checks after a fix and inspect the final diff. Keep local success, remote CI, deployment and published availability as distinct evidence states.

workflows.title: GNCore Diagnosing Bugs
workflows.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions.
workflows.procedure: Gather the failing input, expected contract, environment/revision and full error context. Narrow the issue by testing competing explanations and relevant callers. Deliver a reproducible diagnosis or a clearly bounded unresolved hypothesis instead of claiming a speculative patch fixed it.

workflows.title: GNCore Qa
workflows.description: Validate a software change against acceptance criteria and reproduce observable regressions.
workflows.procedure: Translate the feature brief or bug report into observable acceptance cases. Exercise the main journey and relevant permission, failure, empty, concurrency, or recovery cases. Record exact setup, inputs, commands, and outcomes. For a failure, isolate a reproducible case and distinguish implementation defects from environment limitations. Fix and retest when requested; report checks not performed rather than treating missing evidence as a pass.

workflows.title: GNCore Verification Loop
workflows.description: Select and run checks that expose the changed contract; investigate failures and retain evidence.
workflows.procedure: Select checks that expose the changed contract, run them, inspect failure causes and make a focused correction. Repeat only when the new change or evidence justifies it. Preserve useful logs and stop an unchanged failing cycle to investigate the missing dependency or assumption.

workflows.title: GNCore Security Review
workflows.description: Use this skill when adding authentication, handling user input, working with secrets, creating API endpoints, or implementing payment/sensitive features.
workflows.procedure: Trace attacker-controlled input through trust and authorization boundaries to concrete sinks. Reproduce reachable abuse paths safely and prioritize findings by impact and prerequisites. Verify the fix with negative authorization/input cases without scanning unrelated live systems.

workflows.title: GNCore Agent Security Hardening
workflows.description: Security hardening guidance for AI agent frameworks that process untrusted content, invoke tools, write workspace files, manage runtime identifiers, or handle credentials.
workflows.procedure: Map model input, retrieved content, tool authority, secrets and side-effect boundaries. Treat untrusted instructions as data, validate tool contracts and bound execution. Test injection, unauthorized tool arguments, secret leakage and retry/budget exhaustion with local fixtures.

workflows.title: GNCore Sharp Edges
workflows.description: Identifies error-prone APIs, dangerous configurations, and footgun designs that enable security mistakes.
workflows.procedure: Inspect public APIs and configuration for defaults or combinations that invite a dangerous mistake. Demonstrate a plausible caller error and propose a safer interface, invariant or diagnostic. Distinguish misuse resistance from a confirmed exploitable vulnerability.

workflows.title: GNCore Insecure Defaults
workflows.description: Find unsafe configuration defaults and fail-open behavior in application code and deployment configuration.
workflows.procedure: Trace configuration values from defaults and environment parsing into sensitive operations. Look for development credentials, debug exposure, permissive origin or network rules, disabled verification, unchecked authorization, and fail-open error handling. Demonstrate the reachable unsafe condition in a local test where practical. Propose a secure default and an explicit opt-in for legitimate development cases; preserve a documented migration path and retest both allowed and denied behavior.

workflows.title: GNCore Differential Review
workflows.description: Performs security-focused differential review of code changes.
workflows.procedure: Compare baseline and changed revisions around trust boundaries, validation, state transitions and changed dependencies. Trace security consequences through callers and tests; report only findings supported by a concrete changed behavior and attack or failure scenario.

workflows.title: GNCore Semgrep
workflows.description: Run and interpret a bounded, relevant Semgrep analysis using the available installation.
workflows.procedure: Check the installed Semgrep version, language support and relevant rules before a bounded local scan. Validate representative matches and false positives against code paths, record command/rule versions and preserve machine-readable findings. Do not treat scanner silence as proof of security.

workflows.title: GNCore Codeql
workflows.description: Scans a codebase for security vulnerabilities using CodeQL's interprocedural data flow and taint tracking analysis.
workflows.procedure: Confirm CodeQL support, compiler/database build requirements and query scope for the target language. Build or inspect an authorized local database and run appropriate queries; triage results against actual source/sinks and record limitations when extraction or a language/toolchain is unavailable.

workflows.title: GNCore Sarif Parsing
workflows.description: Parses and processes SARIF files from static analysis tools like CodeQL, Semgrep, or other scanners.
workflows.procedure: Parse SARIF with schema/version awareness, preserving rule IDs, severity, artifact URIs and physical locations. Resolve paths within the intended workspace and handle missing locations/duplicate results explicitly. Test a small known SARIF fixture rather than trusting a tool-specific field layout.

workflows.title: GNCore Supply Chain Risk Auditor
workflows.description: Audits a project's dependencies for supply-chain risk: version-matched advisories for direct dependencies and the full lockfile tree, abandoned or archived upstreams, npm publisher concentration, and install-time script execution.
workflows.procedure: Inventory direct/transitive dependencies and their exact lockfile identities, sources and install-time behavior. Prioritize provenance, maintenance and reachable security risks with evidence. Keep license and vulnerability review distinct and do not run unknown dependency scripts to assess them.

workflows.title: GNCore Git Workflow
workflows.description: Git workflow patterns including branching strategies, commit conventions, keeping history clean and readable, tidying local commits before merging, merge vs rebase, conflict resolution, and collaborative development best practices for teams of all sizes.
workflows.procedure: Inspect branch and working-tree state, stage only the intended files and prepare a reviewable commit history. Preserve unrelated edits and verify the diff and relevant checks. Distinguish a local commit from a pushed branch or merged change; do not rewrite shared history implicitly.

workflows.title: GNCore Delivery Gate
workflows.description: Review acceptance and release evidence, including failures and unresolved risks.
workflows.procedure: Gather the actual acceptance, compatibility, security, artifact and rollback evidence for this change. Report passed, failed, skipped and missing checks and identify a concrete go/no-go reason. A green test suite alone does not authorize publishing or production rollout.

workflows.title: GNCore Cost Tracking
workflows.description: Track and report Claude Code token usage, spending, and budgets from the local ECC cost-tracker metrics log.
workflows.procedure: Define the cost unit and record measured resource/provider usage with runtime/version and workload. Separate known charges, estimates and allocations, and compare like-for-like runs. Do not upload private billing data or introduce a paid tracking service without scope authorization.

workflows.title: GNCore Post Patch Validation
workflows.description: Validates security patches with reproducible baseline-versus-patched evidence, including original exploits, root-cause variants, behavior preservation, regressions, and newly introduced security failures.
workflows.procedure: Re-run the original reproduction and tests at boundaries the patch affects, then inspect the final diff for unintended changes. Verify the patch did not weaken assertions or move the failure downstream. Preserve baseline/candidate evidence and label checks that could not be executed.

workflows.title: GNCore Mutation Testing
workflows.description: Configures mewt or muton campaigns, analyzes surviving mutants, and investigates bugs exposed by testing gaps.
workflows.procedure: Choose important behavior and a bounded mutation scope, verify the baseline suite, then inspect surviving meaningful mutants. Improve assertions or fixtures for real gaps; classify equivalent/unsupported mutants instead of gaming a percentage. Keep expensive or environment-mutating runs explicitly scoped.

workflows.title: GNCore Deep Research
workflows.description: Produce cited research reports from multiple web sources using firecrawl and exa MCP tools — plan sub-questions, search and deep-read sources, then synthesize findings with inline citations and confidence levels.
workflows.procedure: Frame the engineering uncertainty and identify primary sources, relevant code and a reproducible experiment. Compare contradictory evidence by version/method and retain citations. Deliver a decision with limits and next evidence, not an exhaustive uncited survey.

workflows.title: GNCore Research Ops
workflows.description: Evidence-first current-state research workflow for ECC.
workflows.procedure: Record the research question, source/version provenance, retrieval date, reproduction inputs and unresolved claims so another maintainer can repeat the work. Separate a cached source observation from a fresh review and do not silently overwrite accepted evidence.

workflows.title: GNCore Product Capability
workflows.description: Translate PRD intent, roadmap asks, or product discussions into an implementation-ready capability plan that exposes constraints, invariants, interfaces, and unresolved decisions before multi-service work starts.
workflows.procedure: Trace a requested capability through actual user flows, code, data, integrations and operational dependencies. Mark implemented, partial and missing behavior with evidence. Propose a bounded completion path without describing documentation or a mocked screen as a working backend feature.

workflows.title: GNCore To Prd
workflows.description: Turn a product idea into a scoped requirements document with user outcomes and acceptance criteria.
workflows.procedure: Describe the target users, current problem, desired outcome, scope, and explicit non-goals from the supplied context. Define functional behavior, key user journeys, constraints, dependencies, measurable acceptance criteria, and open decisions. Separate observed evidence from assumptions. Keep implementation details only where they constrain the product; avoid invented market claims, delivery estimates, or approvals.

workflows.title: GNCore To Spec
workflows.description: Turn agreed requirements into a local, reviewable technical specification.
workflows.procedure: Convert agreed requirements into explicit actors, inputs, state transitions, public contracts and acceptance examples. Surface contradictions and material unresolved decisions before implementation. Preserve user choices and distinguish normative behavior from illustrative implementation suggestions.

workflows.title: GNCore To Tickets
workflows.description: Split an accepted specification into coherent deliverables with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
workflows.procedure: Split an accepted specification into coherent deliverables with dependencies, scope exclusions and observable acceptance. Keep each ticket independently understandable and connect it to the parent requirement. Avoid arbitrary task fragmentation or creating external issues unless requested.

workflows.title: GNCore Writing Plans
workflows.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
workflows.procedure: Inspect the relevant code paths and risks, then sequence reviewable implementation outcomes with concrete validation. Resolve routine choices from repository context and keep actual blockers explicit. Do not substitute a long plan for authorized implementation work.

workflows.title: GNCore Executing Plans
workflows.description: Use when executing an implementation plan in the current session as the implementer yourself — your human partner chose inline execution, or no subagent tool is available
workflows.procedure: Reconcile the supplied plan with the current working tree, execute the next dependency-ready outcome and verify it. Update the plan when evidence invalidates an assumption, preserving the intended goal. Report concrete results rather than ticking steps whose artifacts do not exist.

workflows.title: GNCore Requesting Code Review
workflows.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements
workflows.procedure: Prepare the actual diff, behavior/specification context and validation evidence for a reviewer. State the decisions or risks that need attention and provide a reproducible example when helpful. Do not send external review requests or messages unless the user authorized them.

workflows.title: GNCore Receiving Code Review
workflows.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions, especially if feedback seems unclear or technically questionable - requires technical rigor and verification, not performative agreement or blind implementation
workflows.procedure: Reproduce or inspect each review claim against the contract and current code. Fix substantiated issues with focused regressions, explain disagreements with evidence and rerun affected checks. Do not accept an incorrect change merely because it was requested by another reviewer.

workflows.title: GNCore Implement
workflows.description: Implement a piece of work based on a spec or set of tickets.
workflows.procedure: Trace the requested behavior through callers and existing conventions, implement the complete scoped change and validate meaningful success/failure cases. Preserve public contracts and unrelated user work; state unavailable integration evidence instead of replacing real behavior with an undisclosed mock.

workflows.title: GNCore Implement Spec
workflows.description: Implement the result of /to-spec and /to-tickets in code.
workflows.procedure: Map specification requirements to code paths and acceptance cases, implement the dependency-ready slice and verify contract/error behavior. Track unmet or contradictory requirements explicitly. Do not broaden the feature or change specified semantics just to fit an easier implementation.

workflows.title: GNCore Python
workflows.description: Pythonic idioms, PEP 8 standards, type hints, and best practices for building robust, efficient, and maintainable Python applications.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the supported Python versions and public contract, implement idiomatic modules with explicit error/data boundaries and avoid unnecessary dependencies. Verify relevant behavior and clean imports under the declared runtime rather than relying on the developer's editable environment.

workflows.title: GNCore Python Testing
workflows.description: Design Python tests around observable contracts, meaningful boundaries and isolated state.
workflows.procedure: Choose unit or integration boundaries around the actual Python contract, use isolated temporary state and test normal, invalid and regression cases. Parameterize meaningful variations and verify cleanup. Mock external boundaries without replacing the behavior the test is supposed to establish.

workflows.title: GNCore Webapp Testing
workflows.description: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright.
workflows.procedure: Run the actual web application with isolated data, exercise a representative journey and assert user-visible outcomes. Check console/network errors, invalid input and relevant states; retain browser/environment evidence. Do not claim visual or interaction validation from a successful server start alone.

workflows.title: GNCore Regression Hunt
workflows.description: Use when investigating regressions in PRs or commits, coordinating a regression campaign, or resuming saved progress.
workflows.procedure: Use baseline/candidate behavior, failing inputs and change history to narrow a regression, employing bisection only when revisions are reproducible. Preserve a minimal reproduction and identify the first meaningful behavioral change before proposing the fix.

workflows.title: GNCore Brainstorming
workflows.description: Explore unresolved software design choices and agree on a practical direction when the brief needs clarification.
workflows.procedure: Explore a small set of viable approaches against the user's constraints and current repository. Identify the uncertain tradeoff and choose a useful next experiment or implementation direction. Keep explicit user decisions intact and avoid an approval ritual for ordinary reversible work.

workflows.title: GNCore Using Git Worktrees
workflows.description: Isolate concurrent coding work in Git worktrees while preserving uncommitted changes and repository conventions.
workflows.procedure: Inspect branch/worktree state and create an isolated checkout only when it helps protect existing work or separate concurrent changes. Use a nonconflicting branch and verify the worktree path. Do not delete user worktrees, rewrite history or assume multiple agents are authorized.

workflows.title: GNCore Subagent Driven Development
workflows.description: Coordinate authorized coding subagents on separable work with explicit interfaces and integration checks.
workflows.procedure: Delegate only when the host supports it and the task authorizes delegation. Give independent work a bounded contract and minimal context, integrate results through actual diff/test review and keep shared mutations coordinated. Complete the work directly when delegation is unavailable or unauthorized.

workflows.title: GNCore Finishing A Development Branch
workflows.description: Prepare a completed development branch for review, integration, or cleanup according to the user's chosen workflow.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the final diff, working tree and validation evidence, then prepare the requested commit/review/release material. Keep push, merge, tag and publication states explicit and honor existing authorization. Do not discard uncommitted work as part of cleanup.

workflows.title: GNCore Workflow Setup
workflows.description: Configure the requested coding workflow's repository context, issue-tracker references, and local skill conventions.
workflows.procedure: Inspect which workflow tools and conventions the project actually requests and preserve existing settings. Prepare a minimal reviewable configuration and verify its commands on a fixture. Do not install unrelated hooks, global agents or mandatory approvals from a source author's personal setup.

workflows.title: GNCore General Coding Workflow
workflows.description: Plan, implement, debug, and verify a software task in its existing language and stack.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the relevant source, current behavior, user request, and repository instructions. Choose the smallest useful set of coding skills for the task: requirements or architecture for unresolved design, the actual stack for implementation, and a suitable testing or debugging workflow for verification. Build the complete requested result, preserve unrelated work, and report concrete evidence. Do not load all installed skills for every task.

workflows.title: Requirements Clarifier
workflows.description: Collects scope, constraints, acceptance criteria, and open questions before implementation starts.
workflows.procedure:
Your job is to turn a rough request into a precise implementation brief.
Ask for missing constraints, surface risks early, capture acceptance criteria, and refuse to guess on critical decisions.
Prefer short, direct questions and summarize the result as a checklist the next skill can execute.

workflows.title: Architecture Designer
workflows.description: Defines system boundaries, interfaces, and implementation constraints.
workflows.procedure:
Convert requirements into a clean, typed architecture.
Define modules, ownership boundaries, data flow, invariants, and failure handling.
Choose the simplest design that can be extended without duplicating logic.

workflows.title: Implementation Builder
workflows.description: Writes production-grade code with minimal duplication and explicit types.
workflows.procedure:
Implement the agreed design directly, keep code explicit and typed, and avoid speculative abstractions.
Make the smallest change that satisfies the contract, then verify it with targeted tests or checks.

workflows.title: Code Reviewer
workflows.description: Finds defects, regressions, and missing coverage before release.
workflows.procedure:
Look for correctness issues, API mismatches, risky assumptions, and missing tests.
State concrete findings first, then give a short summary of residual risk.

workflows.title: Testing Specialist
workflows.description: Designs and validates tests for the changed slice.
workflows.procedure:
Create targeted unit and integration tests that fail before the fix and pass after it.
Prefer clear fixture setup and assertions that verify the observable behavior, not implementation details.

workflows.title: Security Reviewer
workflows.description: Assesses secrets handling, unsafe file access, and privilege boundaries.
workflows.procedure:
Check for unsafe writes, path traversal, secret leakage, and privilege escalation.
Treat file-system code as hostile-input code and require explicit validation.

workflows.title: Documentation Writer
workflows.description: Produces concise user and developer documentation that matches the implementation.
workflows.procedure:
Document the actual command surface, file layout, and operational behavior.
Avoid marketing language and keep examples runnable.

workflows.title: Release Manager
workflows.description: Coordinates versioning, packaging, and verification for shipping.
workflows.procedure:
Ensure packaging metadata is correct, the distribution is reproducible, and release notes reflect the shipped behavior.
Confirm that the repository is publishable before marking the release complete.

workflows.title: Product Discovery
workflows.description: Turn a product idea into a testable problem statement, user evidence plan, and scoped first release.
workflows.procedure: Separate user problem, evidence, assumptions, and proposed solution. Identify target users, current alternatives, constraints, and measurable outcome. Rank unknowns by risk and propose the cheapest test that can resolve them. Define a narrow first release with explicit exclusions and acceptance criteria. Do not present guesses as user research.

workflows.title: Software Feature Delivery
workflows.description: Deliver a scoped software feature using local conventions and verifiable acceptance criteria.
workflows.procedure: Trace the feature through interfaces and data flow, define observable behavior, make the smallest coherent change, add boundary tests, and run targeted regressions. Preserve unrelated user work and report exact checks.

workflows.title: Software Architecture Decision
workflows.description: Compare architecture options against constraints, operations, reversibility, and lifecycle cost.
workflows.procedure: Capture context, quality attributes, constraints, alternatives, trade-offs, failure modes, and a decision owner. Prefer incremental reversible choices and validate assumptions with a small implementation where useful.

workflows.title: Software Code Review
workflows.description: Review a code change for correctness, security, maintainability, and missing regression coverage.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the full diff and relevant callers, identify concrete reproducible findings with severity and file locations, and separate defects from preferences. Confirm fixes with targeted regression checks.

workflows.title: Software Debugging
workflows.description: Diagnose a software failure from reproducible evidence and verify the smallest safe fix.
workflows.procedure: Reproduce or isolate the failing condition, inspect logs and state, form testable hypotheses, and narrow the cause before editing. Add a regression test, fix the root cause, and rerun the failure and impacted checks.

workflows.title: Safe Refactoring
workflows.description: Refactor a bounded code area while preserving its documented behavior and public contracts.
workflows.procedure: Capture behavior with tests or characterization, identify callers, make small mechanical steps, and run tests after each risky step. Avoid unrelated redesign and compare externally observable behavior before and after.

workflows.title: Software API Contract
workflows.description: Define and verify an API contract across request, response, errors, versioning, and consumers.
workflows.procedure: Inspect actual consumers, validate schemas and authorization boundaries, specify error semantics and compatibility, and test contract fixtures. Flag breaking behavior and provide a migration path.

workflows.title: Dependency Change Review
workflows.description: Assess and implement a dependency change with compatibility, security, and rollback evidence.
workflows.procedure: Check supported versions, changelog, transitive effects, license policy, lockfile behavior, and known vulnerabilities. Change only needed packages, run affected tests, and record rollback and compatibility results.

workflows.title: Software Performance Optimization
workflows.description: Find a measured software bottleneck and optimize it without regressing correctness.
workflows.procedure: Establish repeatable workload and baseline, profile the critical path, estimate impact and resource trade-offs, then change one bottleneck. Rerun correctness tests and comparable benchmarks; report uncertainty.

workflows.title: Software Migration Plan
workflows.description: Plan a staged migration with compatibility gates, data safety, and rollback criteria.
workflows.procedure: Inventory dependencies and consumers, define target and interim states, map changes and data movement, and stage by reversible boundaries. Test backward compatibility and rollback before production cutover.

workflows.title: Software Release Candidate
workflows.description: Prepare a software release with reproducible artifacts, verified changes, and rollback readiness.
workflows.procedure: Check version, diff, changelog, build provenance, tests, dependency locks, supported platforms, migrations, and known issues. Separate passed, skipped, and blocked gates; do not publish without authorization.

title: GNCore Computer Vision
description: Build vision datasets, augmentation, detection/segmentation and image inference with task-appropriate evaluation.

workflows.title: Computer Vision
workflows.description: Build vision workflows with robust image handling, leakage-safe splits, and task-appropriate evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect image formats, dimensions, labels, duplicate/near-duplicate groups, and provenance. Split by source, person, or scene where needed to prevent leakage. Normalize consistently and validate augmentations preserve labels. Use task-appropriate metrics and inspect representative errors. Protect biometric and personal imagery; do not download, retain, or expose images without authorization.

workflows.title: Vision dataset integrity
workflows.description: Vision dataset integrity.
workflows.procedure: Inventory image encodings, shapes, corrupt files, annotation bounds and duplicate/subject groups. Split by the group that must generalize, then report per-split counts and excluded records without exposing private imagery.

workflows.title: Image and annotation transforms
workflows.description: Image and annotation transforms.
workflows.procedure: Apply resize/crop/flip consistently to images, boxes, masks and keypoints. Specify coordinate conventions and interpolation separately for images versus categorical masks. Use a synthetic checkerboard and known box to verify exact transformed bounds and clipping.

workflows.title: Detection and segmentation evaluation
workflows.description: Detection and segmentation evaluation.
workflows.procedure: State IoU thresholds, class matching and aggregation before evaluating. Handle empty predictions/annotations explicitly, retain per-class support, and inspect failure examples. Keep confidence-threshold tuning separate from final holdout reporting.

workflows.title: Image inference parity
workflows.description: Image inference parity.
workflows.procedure: Record decoding, orientation, channel order, scaling and normalization with the artifact. Compare a known image through training-validation preprocessing and the serving path. Reject unsupported/corrupt input and bound decoded dimensions and batch memory.

title: GNCore Cybersecurity
description: Review application, dependency, cloud and agent security using concrete attack paths and scoped evidence.

workflows.title: Threat Model
workflows.description: Map assets, trust boundaries, threats, controls, and residual risk for a bounded system.
workflows.procedure: Use an explicit scope and attacker model, diagram data flows and entry points, rank plausible threats, tie mitigations to owners, and record residual risk. Do not probe systems outside authorized scope.

workflows.title: Secure Code Review
workflows.description: Review a code change for exploitable input, identity, authorization, secret, and data-flow flaws.
workflows.procedure: Trace attacker-controlled inputs to sensitive operations, verify server-side authorization and safe encoding, identify reproducible findings, and recommend minimal fixes with regression tests. Avoid unapproved live exploitation.

workflows.title: Vulnerability Triage
workflows.description: Prioritize a reported vulnerability using affected assets, exploitability, exposure, and impact evidence.
workflows.procedure: Verify affected versions and reachable paths, validate evidence in a safe environment, assess exposure and compensating controls, assign severity using policy, and coordinate fix/mitigation and retest.

workflows.title: Cyber Incident Response
workflows.description: Coordinate defensive incident response with containment, evidence preservation, and recovery gates.
workflows.procedure: Establish scope and confidence, preserve logs and chain of custody, select reversible containment with owner approval, coordinate communications, eradicate safely, and verify recovery. Keep hypotheses separate from confirmed facts.

workflows.title: Identity and Access Review
workflows.description: Review identities and permissions for least privilege, lifecycle, ownership, and audit evidence.
workflows.procedure: Inventory human and service identities, roles, privilege, owner, last use, and authentication controls. Validate exceptions and break-glass paths; recommend revocation only through authorized change control.

workflows.title: Cloud Security Review
workflows.description: Assess cloud configuration against an explicit threat model and approved security baseline.
workflows.procedure: Check identity boundaries, public exposure, encryption, network paths, logging, backups, and configuration drift. Cite exact resources and evidence; do not change production settings without authorization.

workflows.title: Security Control Evidence
workflows.description: Map supplied evidence to security control requirements with traceable, bounded conclusions.
workflows.procedure: Use the named control version, identify evidence period and system scope, note sample and gaps, and distinguish designed from operating effectiveness. Do not claim certification or compliance from incomplete evidence.

workflows.title: Phishing Response Triage
workflows.description: Triage a suspected phishing report and provide safe containment and user guidance.
workflows.procedure: Preserve message headers and indicators, verify links without opening them, identify affected users and credential exposure, and route containment through authorized tooling. Do not forward malicious content broadly.

workflows.title: Exposed Secret Response
workflows.description: Respond to a potentially exposed credential without echoing or spreading the secret.
workflows.procedure: Identify credential type and exposure window without printing its value, notify the owner, revoke or rotate using approved procedure, audit use, and remove exposure from accessible history where possible.

workflows.title: Authorized Security Test Plan
workflows.description: Define a bounded security test plan with written authorization, targets, limits, and stop conditions.
workflows.procedure: Record asset owner approval, exact scope, allowed techniques, dates, rate limits, data handling, contacts, and stop rules. Keep testing non-destructive and report only verified findings to authorized recipients.

workflows.title: Web Security Engineering
workflows.description: Review web features for input, session, authorization, and output-handling vulnerabilities.
workflows.procedure: Trace attacker-controlled values from entry to storage and rendering. Check authentication and object-level authorization on every sensitive operation, output encoding, CSRF protections where relevant, secret handling, and safe error responses. Tie findings to code paths and exploit conditions; do not claim a vulnerability without evidence.

workflows.title: Privacy Review
workflows.description: Reduce privacy risk by tracing personal data, purpose, access, retention, and user control.
workflows.procedure: Map data collected, source, purpose, recipients, storage, access, retention, deletion, and user controls. Identify data minimization and security improvements. Flag jurisdiction-specific legal questions rather than asserting compliance. Do not expose raw personal data in logs, examples, or reports; use synthetic or redacted samples.

title: GNCore Data Engineering
description: Build schema-aware, observable batch/streaming pipelines with restart, reconciliation and lineage.

workflows.title: Data Analysis
workflows.description: Answer data questions with reproducible calculations, clear definitions, and honest uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into a measurable quantity and inspect the relevant columns and missingness. Show the denominator, filters, time window, and aggregation. Check duplicates and outliers where they affect the answer. Label estimates and caveats; never fabricate values or imply causation from correlation.

workflows.title: Data Pipeline Engineering
workflows.description: Build reliable, observable data pipelines with explicit schemas, retries, and idempotency.
workflows.procedure: Trace source-to-sink data flow and failure semantics. Define schema and validation at boundaries, make retries idempotent, handle late or duplicate records, and emit actionable logs without secrets or sensitive payloads. Preserve existing schedules and production destinations unless the request explicitly changes them.

workflows.title: Data Pipeline Engineering
workflows.description: Build observable, restartable pipelines with explicit schemas, idempotency, and data-quality checks.
workflows.procedure: Trace source, ownership, freshness, volume, schema evolution, and retry semantics. Make stages idempotent, checkpoint safely, validate schemas and key quality invariants, and expose useful failure context. Protect credentials and sensitive data. Keep backfills bounded and never trigger production backfills or mutate source systems without authorization.

workflows.title: Data Governance
workflows.description: Define practical ownership, quality, access, lineage, and retention controls for a data asset.
workflows.procedure: Identify asset owner, purpose, source, sensitivity, consumers, transformations, quality expectations, and retention. Propose least-privilege access, lineage, quality checks, and deletion handling. Separate policy facts from recommendations and flag legal or regulatory interpretations for experts. Avoid copying sensitive datasets into examples or test fixtures.

title: GNCore Data Science
description: Analyze data, statistics and experiments with correct grain, reproducibility and honest uncertainty.

workflows.title: Product Analytics
workflows.description: Define product metrics and event instrumentation that answer a decision without collecting unnecessary data.
workflows.procedure: Start with the decision and user outcome, then define event grain, actor, timestamp, properties, denominator, and exclusions. Check identity stitching, consent, retention, and duplicate events. Prefer a small event schema with stable names and versioning. Validate counts end to end and document known blind spots. Avoid collecting sensitive attributes without a clear, approved need.

workflows.title: Analytics Question Plan
workflows.description: Translate a business question into a measurable analysis plan and data requirements.
workflows.procedure: Define decision, population, unit of analysis, outcome, comparison, time range, data sources, and limitations before querying. Identify causal language that the available design cannot support.

workflows.title: Data Quality Audit
workflows.description: Audit analytical data for missingness, duplication, validity, freshness, and grain.
workflows.procedure: Profile schema, keys, nulls, ranges, category drift, late arrivals, and row grain. Report counts and affected segments, preserve raw data, and turn material defects into owned checks.

workflows.title: Business SQL Analysis
workflows.description: Write a traceable SQL analysis with correct grain, joins, time handling, and reconciliation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect source definitions, declare expected row grain, parameterize inputs, verify join cardinality, and reconcile totals to a trusted control. Avoid expensive or mutating production queries without authorization.

workflows.title: Decision Dashboard
workflows.description: Design a dashboard around a recurring decision with clear metrics, filters, and data freshness.
workflows.procedure: Name the audience and decision, define metrics and denominators, show time window and freshness, add useful breakdowns, and check accessibility. Remove charts that do not change a decision.

workflows.title: Metric Tree
workflows.description: Decompose a business outcome into leading drivers and measurable operational inputs.
workflows.procedure: Define the top outcome, decompose mathematically or causally only where evidence supports it, annotate owner and source for each metric, and distinguish controllable inputs from external factors.

workflows.title: Cohort Analysis
workflows.description: Compare cohort behavior with consistent definitions, exposure windows, and censoring treatment.
workflows.procedure: Specify cohort entry, event, observation window, time zone, exclusions, and incomplete follow-up. Check cohort comparability and report uncertainty and survivorship bias.

workflows.title: Business Experiment Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze an experiment with assignment, exposure, predeclared outcomes, and uncertainty checks.
workflows.procedure: Validate randomization, sample ratio, instrumentation, metric definition, duration, and stopping rule. Estimate effect with uncertainty and guardrails; do not declare success from post-hoc slicing.

workflows.title: Business Forecast Analysis
workflows.description: Build a business forecast from history, drivers, scenarios, and out-of-sample checks.
workflows.procedure: Check data coverage and structural changes, establish a simple baseline, use time-ordered validation, and compare scenarios. Explain forecast error and avoid false precision or unsupported causal narratives.

workflows.title: Executive Analytics Brief
workflows.description: Turn analysis into a concise decision brief with traceable evidence and caveats.
workflows.procedure: Lead with the decision and finding, show key numbers with units and denominators, link to source and method, explain alternatives and limitations, and specify next actions and owners.

workflows.title: Analytics Data Contract
workflows.description: Specify ownership, schema, quality, freshness, and change handling for an analytics dataset.
workflows.procedure: Document grain, fields, types, allowed values, null semantics, primary keys, freshness SLA, owner, consumers, and compatibility policy. Define tests and an escalation route for breaking changes.

workflows.title: Clean a Dataset
workflows.description: Audit and clean a dataset with explicit, reversible rules for missing values, duplicates, types, and outliers.
workflows.procedure: Profile the raw data before changing it: schema, nulls, duplicate keys, invalid ranges, category variants, and suspicious distributions. Clarify what each row represents and preserve a read-only source. Apply only defensible rules, log affected rows and counts, and keep a reproducible script. Do not silently impute, discard outliers, deduplicate on an arbitrary field, or overwrite the original. Compare before/after summaries and flag ambiguous cases.

workflows.title: Analyze Data
workflows.description: Answer a data question with reproducible analysis, explicit assumptions, and evidence tied to the provided data.
workflows.procedure: Clarify the unit of analysis and question. Inspect data definitions, missingness, time coverage, and possible selection bias before calculating. Use suitable summaries and comparisons; show denominators and uncertainty when relevant. Separate association from causation and observed facts from interpretation. Keep queries or code reproducible, avoid exposing sensitive records, and state what the data cannot establish.

workflows.title: SQL Analysis
workflows.description: Write correct, reviewable SQL for analytics while guarding against join fanout and misleading aggregates.
workflows.procedure: Read table definitions and grain before joining. State the intended row grain, join keys, time zone, null behavior, and filters. Check for fanout and use explicit columns. Validate row counts, distinct keys, and edge cases against a small known sample. Avoid expensive full scans or writes on production systems unless explicitly authorized; explain assumptions and query cost risks.

workflows.title: Data Visualization
workflows.description: Create clear charts that faithfully represent the underlying data and its uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Match chart form to the question and data type. Label units, denominators, time range, and transformations; show missing data and uncertainty when material. Use honest axes and accessible color/labels. Validate plotted values against source aggregates and avoid implying causality from descriptive data. Keep dashboards focused on decisions and explain filters and refresh timing.

workflows.title: Statistical Analysis
workflows.description: Choose and interpret statistical methods with assumptions, uncertainty, and practical effects stated clearly.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into an estimand and identify sampling and assignment mechanisms. Check assumptions, missingness, dependence, and multiple testing. Report effect size and uncertainty, not just a p-value. Distinguish exploratory findings from confirmatory analysis and association from causation. Do not imply a result is actionable without considering study design and practical impact.

workflows.title: A/B Test Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze controlled experiments with valid assignment checks, predeclared metrics, and practical uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Confirm randomization unit, exposure, experiment window, primary metric, guardrails, and stopping rule. Check sample-ratio mismatch, logging gaps, interference, and repeated peeking. Estimate effect with uncertainty and predeclared method; handle multiple comparisons explicitly. Report absolute and relative impact and segment findings as exploratory unless preplanned. Do not declare a winner from an underpowered or invalid test.

workflows.title: Geospatial Analysis
workflows.description: Analyze spatial data with explicit coordinate systems, units, geometry validity, and privacy controls.
workflows.procedure: Inspect coordinate reference systems, units, geometry validity, spatial grain and boundary versions. For distance or area, choose a suitable projected CRS or a justified geodesic calculation for the extent and distortion; reprojection alone does not ensure accuracy. Validate spatial joins for duplicates and boundary effects, disclose aggregation and protect sensitive locations.

quality_revision.reason: Allow correct geodesic analysis instead of universally requiring reprojection.

title: GNCore Databases and SQL
description: Design relational schemas, SQL, transactions, indexes and reversible data migrations.

workflows.title: Database Design
workflows.description: Design safe relational data models, queries, and migrations that preserve integrity and performance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the database engine, schema, constraints, data volume, and access patterns. Encode invariants with appropriate constraints and indexes; parameterize input. Make migrations reversible and consider locking, backfill, and compatibility. Never run destructive SQL or apply a migration to production without explicit authorization. Verify query plans or migration behavior with a safe local fixture when possible.

workflows.title: Transaction and concurrency invariants
workflows.description: Transaction and concurrency invariants.
workflows.procedure: Express the business invariant with keys/checks and the chosen isolation/locking strategy. Reproduce a two-writer conflict using an isolated database and show which operation retries or fails. Keep the transaction boundary around the complete invariant.

workflows.title: Query plan and index analysis
workflows.description: Query plan and index analysis.
workflows.procedure: Record schema, distribution, query parameters and an explain plan on representative fixtures. Identify scan/join/order costs and compare a targeted index using the same workload. Account for write amplification and avoid declaring an index useful from syntax alone.

workflows.title: Expand/backfill/contract migration
workflows.description: Expand/backfill/contract migration.
workflows.procedure: Inventory existing values and define explicit handling of unknown or colliding data. Add a compatible representation and coordinate old/new writers before and throughout a resumable bounded backfill; use reconciliation or a final catch-up to close concurrent-write gaps. Check the actual engine/version constraint and lock semantics, validate integrity, then switch readers and contract only after overlap is over. State the last reversible step, mapping/backup needs and forward recovery after destructive contraction; rehearse interruption and recovery without claiming unexecuted SQL.

quality_revision.reason: Close dual-writer backfill races and define realistic recovery boundaries.

workflows.title: Backup restoration evidence
workflows.description: Backup restoration evidence.
workflows.procedure: Define recovery-point/time requirements and the backup's consistency boundary. Restore into an isolated instance and verify schema, row counts, critical queries and recovery steps. A successful backup command alone is not evidence of a working restore.

title: GNCore Deep Learning
description: Engineer reproducible deep-learning training, checkpointing, fine-tuning and distributed optimization.

workflows.title: Model Fine-Tuning
workflows.description: Plan or implement a parameter-efficient or full fine-tuning workflow with controlled data and cost.
workflows.procedure: Confirm the base model, license constraints, data rights, objective, validation method, hardware, and budget. Inspect existing training code and use the least costly method that can answer the goal. Keep validation data separate, record model and tokenizer revisions, and save to a new checkpoint path. Do not launch paid or long-running jobs without explicit approval.

workflows.title: PyTorch Training
workflows.description: Implement PyTorch training loops with correct device, optimizer, checkpoint, and evaluation handling.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed PyTorch version and existing dataset/model interfaces. Set train/eval modes correctly, move batches and model to the same device, clear gradients, and use inference mode for evaluation. Save checkpoints atomically to a new path and include enough state to resume when requested. Start with a tiny smoke run before a full run.

workflows.title: TensorFlow and Keras Training
workflows.description: Build TensorFlow/Keras training workflows with explicit data, callbacks, and evaluation behavior.
workflows.procedure: Inspect TensorFlow/Keras version and data pipeline semantics. Keep preprocessing consistent, avoid validation leakage, configure callbacks explicitly, and save to a new artifact path. Check output shapes and a small batch first. Do not assume GPU availability or start a long training run without user approval.

workflows.title: Deep Learning Engineering
workflows.description: Develop deep learning code with explicit tensor shapes, stable optimization, and reproducible evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect framework versions, model inputs/outputs, tensor shapes, precision, memory limits, and baseline. Verify loss/activation compatibility, masking, gradient flow, and train/eval modes. Keep validation data out of gradient updates and log checkpoints with configuration. Do not launch GPU-intensive jobs or replace checkpoints without approval. Diagnose with a tiny batch before scaling.

workflows.title: Checkpoint and resume equivalence
workflows.description: Checkpoint and resume equivalence.
workflows.procedure: Save model, optimizer, scheduler, precision scaler, step and relevant RNG/data-loader state together. Load with device/version awareness. Compare a short uninterrupted run with a stopped/resumed run under stated determinism limits; avoid treating weights alone as a resumable training state.

workflows.title: Mixed precision correctness
workflows.description: Mixed precision correctness.
workflows.procedure: Establish a float32 reference and identify numerically sensitive operations. Use the framework's current autocast/scaling APIs, unscale before clipping, and check skipped/nonfinite steps. Compare validation quality and peak memory on the target device rather than assuming a speedup.

workflows.title: Gradient accumulation
workflows.description: Gradient accumulation.
workflows.procedure: Define the desired effective batch and loss normalization, including a short final microbatch. Zero gradients at the correct accumulation boundary, and step the optimizer/scheduler only when an update occurs. Compare gradients with a single equivalent batch where layer behavior permits.

workflows.title: Distributed training correctness
workflows.description: Distributed training correctness.
workflows.procedure: Define rank ownership, sampler sharding, collective order and globally reduced metrics. Check duplicate/dropped examples, uneven last batches and checkpoint ownership. Prove a tiny multi-process run before scaling and retain logs for rank-specific hangs; do not silently launch a costly cluster.

workflows.title: Transfer learning and freezing
workflows.description: Transfer learning and freezing.
workflows.procedure: Verify checkpoint provenance and architecture compatibility. Explicitly select frozen/trainable parameters, normalization behavior and optimizer groups. Compare a frozen baseline with bounded fine-tuning on the same split; verify frozen weights remain unchanged.

title: GNCore UX and Design Systems
description: Design developer-facing and product interfaces, flows, accessible interaction and reusable component systems.

workflows.title: UX Research
workflows.description: Plan and synthesize ethical user research that ties observations to product decisions.
workflows.procedure: Define the decision and research question before selecting a method. Recruit representative participants, use neutral prompts, obtain consent, and minimize personal data. Distinguish direct observation from interpretation; preserve contradictory evidence. Summarize themes with confidence and limitations, then map findings to testable design changes. Never invent participant quotes or counts.

workflows.title: Design System Engineering
workflows.description: Extend a design system with accessible tokens and reusable components that fit existing conventions.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing tokens, components, naming, accessibility states, and consumers. Reuse established primitives; add the smallest composable API. Define default, hover, focus, disabled, error, and responsive behavior as relevant. Validate contrast and interaction semantics. Document migration or deprecation when a public component contract changes.

workflows.title: UX Usability Audit
workflows.description: Audit a user flow for task clarity, feedback, recovery, cognitive load, and accessibility.
workflows.procedure: Perform the stated task using the current interface, record friction with steps and evidence, distinguish observation from inference, and rank fixes by task impact and confidence.

workflows.title: User Flow Design
workflows.description: Map a user journey with entry points, decisions, states, errors, and successful completion.
workflows.procedure: Identify user goal, preconditions, system responses, branches, recovery, and accessibility needs. Validate the flow against product constraints and test the highest-risk transition.

workflows.title: Wireframe Specification
workflows.description: Specify a wireframe around user priorities, information hierarchy, and responsive states.
workflows.procedure: Define page purpose, content priority, primary action, supporting controls, loading/empty/error states, and breakpoints. Keep behavior and content clear before visual polish.

workflows.title: Minimalist UI Direction
workflows.description: Create a restrained interface with clear hierarchy, intentional whitespace, and accessible controls.
