workflows.procedure: Use a compact type/color system and strong alignment; retain status and essential actions, maintain contrast and visible focus, and remove ornament that does not help the task.

workflows.title: Expressive UI Direction
workflows.description: Create a distinctive, layered interface without sacrificing navigation, readability, or accessibility.
workflows.procedure: Choose a small set of expressive elements with clear hierarchy, test readable text and controls, preserve responsive behavior, and ensure each visual detail supports brand or content.

workflows.title: Design System Component
workflows.description: Specify a reusable design-system component with API, states, semantics, and adoption guidance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing tokens and components, define component purpose and composition, document interaction and state behavior, check accessibility, and include migration or deprecation notes for changed contracts.

workflows.title: UX Content Design
workflows.description: Write interface text that helps users understand choices, status, errors, and recovery.
workflows.procedure: Use the user's vocabulary, state the consequence before action, keep labels specific, explain errors with a next step, and verify length and localization constraints.

workflows.title: Prototype Test Plan
workflows.description: Create a prototype test plan that resolves a specific interaction or comprehension question.
workflows.procedure: Define a single learning goal, representative participant criteria, realistic tasks, neutral prompts, observation rubric, and decision threshold. Avoid presenting a prototype preference as validated demand.

workflows.title: Accessible Interaction Design
workflows.description: Design keyboard, screen-reader, motion, contrast, and touch behavior into an interaction.
workflows.procedure: Specify semantic role, name, focus order, keyboard model, announcements, target size, contrast, and reduced-motion behavior. Validate with manual interaction in addition to automated scanning.

workflows.title: Design to Engineering Handoff
workflows.description: Prepare a design handoff with behavior, states, assets, responsive rules, and unresolved questions.
workflows.procedure: Annotate component reuse, tokens, breakpoints, interaction states, content, asset sources and acceptance criteria. Compare the implementation with this specification and record concrete deviations. When a designer is available and review is in scope, resolve differences together; absence of a collaborator must not prevent delivery of a reviewable artifact.

quality_revision.reason: Make collaborator review conditional while preserving implementation acceptance.

title: GNCore Technical Research
description: Investigate technical options, papers, APIs and reproducible engineering experiments from primary evidence.

workflows.title: Research Synthesis
workflows.description: Synthesize supplied or sourced evidence with provenance, disagreement, and uncertainty kept visible.
workflows.procedure: Translate the question into scope, date range, and evidence standard. Prioritize primary sources; record citation details and distinguish source claims from your synthesis. Compare methods and note conflicting findings, limitations, and missing evidence. Do not invent citations, quotations, or consensus. State when evidence is insufficient or likely outdated.

workflows.title: API and dependency compatibility
workflows.description: API and dependency compatibility.
workflows.procedure: Inspect installed versions, call sites, official release notes and primary API documentation. Reproduce the needed behavior in a minimal fixture and record migration/compatibility constraints before recommending a dependency change.

workflows.title: Research result reproduction
workflows.description: Research result reproduction.
workflows.procedure: Record the paper revision, dataset rights/splits, baseline, metric definitions and compute budget. Reproduce the smallest decisive experiment first, keep deviations visible and separate a partial implementation from replication of published results.

workflows.title: Evidence-backed technical decision
workflows.description: Evidence-backed technical decision.
workflows.procedure: Compare options on the project's actual constraints, prototype the uncertain boundary and cite primary evidence with dates/versions. State what would change the recommendation; do not substitute general popularity for workload evidence.

title: GNCore Developer Tools
description: Build reliable CLIs, developer workflows, editor integrations and local tooling.

workflows.title: CLI Engineering
workflows.description: Design command-line tools with predictable arguments, clear errors, safe defaults, and scriptable output.
workflows.procedure: Inspect established command patterns and automation needs. Use explicit options, stable exit codes, actionable errors, and non-interactive behavior for scripts. Make destructive actions opt-in and support dry-run when useful. Keep stdout machine-readable when promised and send diagnostics to stderr. Test help, invalid input, and representative success/failure cases.

workflows.title: Reproducible developer environments
workflows.description: Reproducible developer environments.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing lockfiles, compiler/runtime versions and setup scripts. Pin the reproducibility boundary without adding an unrelated toolchain; verify a clean setup and document platform-specific requirements, cache assumptions and offline limits.

title: GNCore Distributed Systems
description: Design and implement concurrency, queues, replication and failure recovery across service boundaries.

workflows.title: Idempotent operations
workflows.description: Idempotent operations.
workflows.procedure: Define the operation identity, key scope, retention and same-key/different-payload behavior. Persist result and side effect within the consistency boundary, and replay after simulated timeout/crash. Do not implement exactly-once claims with an in-memory duplicate set.

workflows.title: Queue delivery and recovery
workflows.description: Queue delivery and recovery.
workflows.procedure: State ordering, delivery guarantees, acknowledgment point and poison-message policy. Test duplicate/redelivered messages and a crash between side effect and acknowledgment. Bound retries and dead-letter handling without silently dropping work.

workflows.title: Consistency and stale writers
workflows.description: Consistency and stale writers.
workflows.procedure: Identify which reads/writes require linearizable, transactional or eventual behavior. Define version/fencing tokens and test a stale owner after lease expiry. Make unavailable versus stale responses explicit during partial failure.

workflows.title: Timeouts, backoff and retry budgets
workflows.description: Timeouts, backoff and retry budgets.
workflows.procedure: Allocate an end-to-end deadline and propagate cancellation to dependencies. Retry only safe transient failures with bounded jitter/backoff and a shared budget. Simulate ambiguous timeout completion and prevent retry amplification across layers.

title: GNCore Documentation
description: Write technical references, tutorials, API documentation and migration guides from verified software behavior.

workflows.title: Technical Localization
workflows.description: Adapt technical content across languages while preserving product meaning, UI limits, and verified terminology.
workflows.procedure: Identify source locale, target locale, audience, and approved glossary. Preserve code, placeholders, links, units, legal meaning, and formatting tokens. Flag ambiguous source text instead of guessing. Use locale-appropriate dates and numbers; do not translate identifiers. Verify UI length and right-to-left behavior when relevant.

workflows.title: Technical Writing
workflows.description: Write accurate, task-oriented technical documentation with runnable examples and clear prerequisites.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the actual behavior and audience before drafting. Put the shortest successful path first, identify prerequisites and supported versions, and verify commands and output. Keep terminology consistent and label assumptions. Do not document unimplemented behavior or expose credentials. Update nearby references when a public command or interface changes.

workflows.title: API Documentation
workflows.description: Document API behavior from the implementation and contract, with examples users can reproduce.
workflows.procedure: Inspect routes, schemas, authentication, error behavior, and versioning. Document required and optional fields, examples, pagination, rate limits, and known constraints. Verify examples against a safe environment or schema. Keep secrets and personal data out. Clearly flag undocumented behavior instead of guessing.

title: GNCore Embedded Systems
description: Build firmware, peripheral interfaces and constrained-device software with explicit timing and hardware boundaries.

workflows.title: Firmware state machines
workflows.description: Firmware state machines.
workflows.procedure: Separate pure state transitions from peripheral effects. Define events, deadlines and valid states; make retries bounded and recovery explicit. Simulate event sequences, repeated inputs and reset without requiring a device.

workflows.title: Peripheral protocol integration
workflows.description: Peripheral protocol integration.
workflows.procedure: Verify board pins, voltage assumptions, bus configuration, frame format and timeout behavior against the actual hardware documentation. Isolate the transport behind a testable boundary and inject truncated, delayed and corrupt frames in host tests.

workflows.title: Timers and interrupt boundaries
workflows.description: Timers and interrupt boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Define tick units, counter width, wraparound and interrupt/main-loop ownership. Keep interrupt work bounded and use wrap-safe elapsed-time comparisons. Test deadlines across counter rollover and report which timing claims still require hardware measurement.

workflows.title: Constrained memory and firmware builds
workflows.description: Constrained memory and firmware builds.
workflows.procedure: Record flash/RAM limits, stack/heap use and linker configuration for the target. Prefer bounded buffers and deterministic allocation where required. Inspect map/build output and exercise maximum frames and reset paths; desktop simulation does not certify device memory headroom.

title: GNCore Game Development
description: Build playable game mechanics, simulation state, assets and measured runtime performance.

workflows.title: Game Development
workflows.description: Implement game features with deterministic state transitions, responsive input, and measurable performance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect engine version, scene/entity patterns, update loop, save format, and target platforms. Keep game state transitions explicit and input responsive; handle pause, restart, and persistence as applicable. Profile before optimizing and validate on target hardware when possible. Avoid changing unrelated gameplay balance or publishing builds without authorization.

title: GNCore Machine Learning
description: Develop classical ML and time-series experiments with leakage-safe splits, baselines and deployment-relevant evaluation.

workflows.title: ML Problem Framing
workflows.description: Decide whether a machine learning approach fits the task, data, constraints, and failure costs.
workflows.procedure: Define prediction or generation target, users, action, baseline, data rights, latency/cost limits, error costs, and non-ML alternatives. Set measurable acceptance and stop criteria before choosing a model.

workflows.title: ML Dataset Audit
workflows.description: Audit dataset provenance, schema, representativeness, label quality, leakage, and split strategy.
workflows.procedure: Profile source, labels, duplicates, missingness, time coverage, sensitive fields, and collection process. Group splits by user/entity/time where needed; preserve raw data and document exclusion rules.

workflows.title: ML Preprocessing Pipeline
workflows.description: Build deterministic preprocessing that prevents leakage and preserves training-to-serving parity.
workflows.procedure: Fit learned transforms only on training data, persist the pipeline, validate schema and edge cases, and compare transformed distributions across splits. Track every row or column excluded and why.

workflows.title: ML Model Training Run
workflows.description: Implement a reproducible model training run with configuration, baseline, checkpoints, and evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect framework and hardware, establish baseline, lock data split and metric, set seed and run metadata, and checkpoint safely. Do not launch expensive compute or overwrite artifacts without explicit user authorization.

workflows.title: ML Model Evaluation
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality, uncertainty, subgroup behavior, and representative errors against a baseline.
workflows.procedure: Use a held-out split untouched by tuning, task-appropriate metrics, confidence estimates where practical, and error slices. State sample limits and do not infer safety or production readiness from aggregate scores.

workflows.title: ML Improvement Loop
workflows.description: Improve a model through controlled experiments with a fixed evaluation protocol and root-cause analysis.
workflows.procedure: Rank hypotheses from observed errors, change one factor at a time, track config and artifacts, compare against baseline, diagnose regressions, fix or revert, then rerun focused and regression evaluations until gates pass or a blocker remains.

workflows.title: LLM Evaluation Suite
workflows.description: Evaluate an LLM feature with representative tasks, rubrics, adversarial cases, latency, and cost.
workflows.procedure: Create a privacy-safe eval set, use deterministic checks where possible, score subjective quality with a rubric, and record model/prompt/tool versions. Separate benchmark performance from real-world safety claims.

workflows.title: RAG Grounding Workflow
workflows.description: Build and evaluate retrieval-augmented answers with source access controls and abstention.
workflows.procedure: Preserve source identity and permissions through ingestion and retrieval; measure retrieval separately from answer quality; cite evidence; test missing, conflicting, stale, and unauthorized sources; abstain when support is insufficient.

workflows.title: Model Fine-Tuning Plan
workflows.description: Assess fine-tuning suitability and prepare a controlled, leakage-safe fine-tuning workflow.
workflows.procedure: Compare prompt, retrieval, and fine-tuning alternatives; verify dataset rights and de-identification; deduplicate and split before training; define eval and rollback. Require approval before paid training or external data upload.

workflows.title: Model Release and Monitoring
workflows.description: Prepare a model release with provenance, compatibility, rollback, and drift monitoring gates.
workflows.procedure: Link code, data, config, artifact, eval, serving contract, and owner. Gate release on tested rollback and monitoring for quality, latency, cost, and drift; do not deploy without explicit authorization.

workflows.title: Machine Learning Workflow
workflows.description: Develop a scoped machine learning feature, from data inspection and baseline selection through evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Help with the machine learning task the user describes. Inspect available data, code, and constraints before choosing an approach. Explain the baseline and evaluation metric, preserve reproducibility, and avoid leaking target information. Keep changes limited to the requested workflow. Do not download data, train expensive models, alter production pipelines, or replace existing modeling choices without explicit direction. Report assumptions, results, and limitations.

workflows.title: Model Training
workflows.description: Set up or improve a reproducible model training run with clear configuration, checkpoints, and evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Help carry out the model training task the user describes. Inspect the current training code and hardware/runtime constraints first. Prefer a small reproducible configuration, explicit seeds where supported, documented data splits, and an evaluation step. Do not launch long or costly training jobs, overwrite checkpoints, change datasets, or modify deployment settings unless the user explicitly requests it. Make the smallest relevant code change and explain how to run the training command.

workflows.title: Train a Machine Learning Model
workflows.description: Build and run a reproducible model training workflow with a baseline, tracked configuration, and held-out evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the dataset, task, framework, hardware, and existing pipeline before editing. Establish a simple baseline and define the target metric first. Split by entity or time when random splitting would leak information; fit preprocessing on training data only. Make seeds, hyperparameters, data version, and checkpoints explicit. Implement the requested training path, but do not launch costly or long-running jobs, download data, overwrite checkpoints, or alter production resources without clear authorization. Report the exact command, observed metrics, artifacts, and limitations; never fabricate a completed run.

workflows.title: Preprocess Machine Learning Data
workflows.description: Design a repeatable preprocessing pipeline that preserves schema, prevents leakage, and records transformations.
workflows.procedure: Inspect schema, units, missingness, target definition, split strategy, and downstream model assumptions. Create deterministic transformations fit only on training data and reuse them unchanged on validation/test data. Preserve source data; make output paths explicit and avoid silent row drops, target leakage, or irreversible coercion. Test edge cases and document each transformation, resulting schema, and unresolved data-quality issue.

workflows.title: Evaluate a Model
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality with leakage-safe splits, task-appropriate metrics, baselines, and error analysis.
workflows.procedure: Confirm the prediction target, intended use, split boundaries, class balance, and decision costs. Compare against a simple baseline using metrics suited to the task; report uncertainty or repeated-split variation where practical. Keep test data untouched during tuning. Inspect segment performance and representative errors without exposing sensitive examples. Distinguish measured results from estimates, state data and compute limits, and never claim fairness, robustness, or production readiness from one aggregate score.

workflows.title: Improve a Machine Learning Model
workflows.description: Find evidence-based model improvements through error analysis and controlled experiments against a fixed baseline.
workflows.procedure: Start from the current baseline, metric, split, and failure examples. Rank likely improvements by evidence, expected impact, and cost; change one factor per experiment where possible. Keep the evaluation set fixed and avoid tuning on test data. Track config, seed, data version, metrics, and compute. Do not run expensive experiments, replace a working model, or change serving behavior without authorization. Report wins, regressions, uncertainty, and the next best experiment.

workflows.title: ML Data Preparation
workflows.description: Prepare reproducible model datasets while preventing leakage and preserving provenance.
workflows.procedure: Inspect schema, label definition, missingness, duplicates, time boundaries, and source provenance before transformation. Split data before fitting learned preprocessing; keep related users, groups, or time periods together when required. Never silently drop rows or labels. Record transformations and counts so the run can be reproduced.

workflows.title: Feature Engineering
workflows.description: Build features that are valid at prediction time and reproducible across training and inference.
workflows.procedure: For every candidate feature, state its source, type, availability time, and transformation. Reject features unavailable at prediction time. Fit statistics only on training data, keep train/serve transformations consistent, and compare against a baseline using the same split and metric. Add complexity only when evaluation supports it.

workflows.title: Model Evaluation
workflows.description: Evaluate model quality with valid splits, suitable metrics, uncertainty, and error analysis.
workflows.procedure: Choose metrics from the real decision and class balance, not convenience. Keep tuning data separate from final test data, report sample counts and split rules, compare with a baseline, and inspect important error slices. Quantify uncertainty when feasible. Do not present a single score as proof of generalization or fairness.

workflows.title: Feature Engineering Practice
workflows.description: Create leakage-safe, interpretable features that match the model's serving-time information.
workflows.procedure: For each feature, define its meaning, availability time, source, missing-value semantics, and serving computation. Ensure it uses only information available at prediction time. Fit learned transforms on training data; preserve train/serve parity. Check leakage, drift, cardinality, and subgroup effects. Keep feature logic reproducible and document dropped or transformed columns.

workflows.title: Time-Series Modeling
workflows.description: Analyze and forecast time-indexed data with temporal splits, leakage controls, and useful uncertainty.
workflows.procedure: Inspect frequency, time zone, gaps, revisions, horizon, and forecast origin. Use rolling or forward-chaining evaluation, never random splits. Compare with seasonal-naive baselines and ensure every feature is available at forecast time. Report horizon-specific error and uncertainty; avoid extrapolating beyond evidence. Preserve temporal ordering in preprocessing and backtests.

title: GNCore MLOps
description: Package, serve, monitor and roll back models with reproducible artifacts and explicit promotion gates.

workflows.title: Reproducible ML Experiments
workflows.description: Make model experiments traceable across code, data, configuration, environment, and artifacts.
workflows.procedure: Capture the source revision, dataset/version, configuration, seed, dependencies, model identifier, metrics, and artifact location. Keep secrets out of logs. Make repeated runs distinguishable and avoid overwriting artifacts. Use the repository's existing tracker; add a new service only when requested.

workflows.title: Model Serving and Inference APIs
workflows.description: Package model inference behind a reliable API with validation, resource limits, and observable behavior.
workflows.procedure: Trace model loading and inference lifecycle, validate inputs and output shapes, set appropriate timeouts and resource limits, and preserve version identity. Handle cold starts and model errors explicitly. Do not deploy, expose endpoints, or change production configuration unless requested. Measure latency and memory before claiming capacity.

workflows.title: MLOps and Model Release
workflows.description: Package, register, and monitor models with reproducible artifacts and explicit release gates.
workflows.procedure: Trace training data, code, dependencies, model artifact, evaluation, and serving contract. Define reproducible build metadata, compatibility checks, rollback path, and monitoring for drift and failures. Keep credentials outside artifacts. Do not deploy, promote, or alter production traffic without explicit authorization. Separate offline evidence from live performance and define an owner for alerts.

workflows.title: Machine Learning Experiment Tracking
workflows.description: Make model experiments comparable with consistent splits, metrics, configuration, and artifact provenance.
workflows.procedure: Define the question and baseline before changing code. Record data version, split, code revision, config, seed, environment, metrics, and artifact path for every run. Compare like with like and account for randomness. Keep experiments isolated and avoid overwriting outputs. Do not introduce a tracking service or upload sensitive data without approval.

workflows.title: Model Documentation
workflows.description: Document a model's intended use, data provenance, evaluation, limitations, and deployment assumptions.
workflows.procedure: Use only verified project evidence for training data, method, metrics, and provenance. State intended and excluded uses, evaluation setup, subgroup coverage, limitations, monitoring, and update cadence. Mark unknowns plainly. Do not infer consent, representativeness, fairness, or regulatory status without evidence.

workflows.title: Edge and Hardware-Constrained ML
workflows.description: Adapt inference to constrained hardware using measured latency, memory, and accuracy tradeoffs.
workflows.procedure: Identify target processor, runtime, memory, latency, power, and accuracy requirements. Measure an unoptimized baseline on representative inputs. Compare quantization or compression with task metrics and worst-case behavior; verify supported operators and numerical drift. Keep original artifacts and provide a rollback path. Do not claim deployment readiness from desktop measurements.

workflows.title: Model artifact and provenance
workflows.description: Model artifact and provenance.
workflows.procedure: Bundle model and preprocessing state with input schema, dependency versions, data/split identity and verified evaluation. Hash files and round-trip the bundle in a clean environment. Keep credentials and unnecessary training records outside the artifact.

workflows.title: Prediction service contract
workflows.description: Prediction service contract.
workflows.procedure: Validate feature names/order, dtype, missingness and batch bounds before inference. Use the artifact's exact preprocessing and test predictions against an offline fixture. Define load failures, timeouts and incompatible model/schema errors without silently changing predictions.

workflows.title: Drift and model monitoring
workflows.description: Drift and model monitoring.
workflows.procedure: Separate input drift, label/target changes, prediction drift and service reliability. Define reference windows, delayed-label availability, thresholds and an accountable response. Test a synthetic shifted fixture; do not label input drift alone as measured accuracy degradation.

workflows.title: Model promotion and rollback
workflows.description: Model promotion and rollback.
workflows.procedure: Compare candidate and baseline on the same accepted evaluation set and compatibility checks. Prepare canary/shadow criteria, immutable model identities and a tested rollback path. Keep actual production promotion and traffic changes pending deployment authorization.

title: GNCore Mobile Development
description: Build mobile applications with lifecycle-safe state, offline behavior and platform-appropriate interaction.

workflows.title: Mobile App Engineering
workflows.description: Implement mobile features with reliable navigation, offline behavior, accessibility, and platform conventions.
workflows.procedure: Identify the framework, supported OS versions, navigation, persistence, and permission model first. Follow existing platform conventions and handle loading, empty, error, offline, and denied-permission states. Keep secrets out of the client, minimize collected data, and test small/large screens and accessibility settings. Avoid platform migrations or store submissions unless requested.

title: GNCore NLP and Language Pipelines
description: Build tokenization, text classification, sequence labeling and language-model adaptation pipelines.

workflows.title: Natural Language Processing
workflows.description: Build NLP pipelines that respect language, label quality, privacy, and task-specific evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Inspect languages, tokenization, labels, privacy constraints, and intended use. Establish a simple baseline and split by user/document when duplicates could leak. Evaluate per-class and per-language behavior, not only one aggregate metric. Minimize retention of raw text and redact sensitive examples. Treat generated labels as noisy; document model and data provenance. Do not claim factuality or safety from benchmark scores alone.

workflows.title: Token and label alignment
workflows.description: Token and label alignment.
workflows.procedure: Preserve original text and tokenizer offsets. Define labels for special tokens and subwords, mask ignored positions from loss/metrics and test Unicode plus truncation boundaries. Inspect a hand-labeled example end to end instead of assuming token counts align.

workflows.title: Text classification baseline
workflows.description: Text classification baseline.
workflows.procedure: Split related documents/users before fitting vocabulary or learning preprocessing. Establish a simple lexical baseline, inspect label imbalance and tune thresholds on validation data. Report per-class support/errors and test empty, long and out-of-language input.

workflows.title: Sequence masks and generation
workflows.description: Sequence masks and generation.
workflows.procedure: Specify padding side, attention masks, causal visibility, target shifting and stop tokens. Check a short hand-computed sequence for future-token leakage and ignored padding. Bound generation length and verify batch versus single-input behavior.

workflows.title: Language and task evaluation
workflows.description: Language and task evaluation.
workflows.procedure: Choose metrics that correspond to classification, retrieval, extraction or generation, and retain dataset/language provenance. Examine errors by language/length and independent source groups. Separate semantic accuracy from surface similarity and reviewer preference.

title: GNCore Neural Networks
description: Design and debug neural networks through tensor contracts, gradient checks, loss semantics and tiny-batch experiments.

workflows.title: Tensor and target contracts
workflows.description: Tensor and target contracts.
workflows.procedure: Write a table of each layer's input/output axes, dtype, device and target encoding. Test batch size one and non-square shapes to expose accidental broadcasting. Make reductions explicit and reject an incompatible target before the optimizer step.

workflows.title: Gradient verification
workflows.description: Gradient verification.
workflows.procedure: Use numerical gradients for custom mathematical operations or suspected derivative errors. Compare analytic and central-difference derivatives on a tiny float64 smooth case, restoring parameters after each perturbation. Freeze random/stateful behavior and use identical reduction/data for both evaluations; avoid nonsmooth activation boundaries. Check extreme-logit stability separately. Standard-layer changes may need forward/backward or tiny-batch update tests instead of a full numerical-gradient sweep.

quality_revision.reason: Condition numerical checks and control stochastic/stateful comparisons.

workflows.title: Diagnose a stalled training step
workflows.description: Diagnose a stalled training step.
workflows.procedure: Freeze randomness and overfit a tiny labeled batch. Inspect finite inputs/logits/loss, gradient norms, learning rate and before/after weights. Verify zero_grad/backward/step order and whether parameters are registered and require gradients before changing architecture.

workflows.title: Loss and activation semantics
workflows.description: Loss and activation semantics.
workflows.procedure: Match binary, multiclass or multilabel targets to the selected loss API. Determine whether it expects logits or probabilities, target dtype, class dimension, masking and reduction. Test a hand-computed example; avoid applying softmax twice or averaging padding as real targets.

workflows.title: Initialization and signal flow
workflows.description: Initialization and signal flow.
workflows.procedure: Inspect layer fan-in/fan-out and activation distributions on a fixed batch. Compare saturation, activation variance and gradient norms across depth. Change initialization or normalization only with a diagnosed signal-flow problem and retain a measured baseline.

workflows.title: Evaluation and validation isolation
workflows.description: Evaluation and validation isolation.
workflows.procedure: Switch training-dependent layers to evaluation behavior and disable gradient recording for inference. Verify validation does not update parameters or running statistics and restore training mode afterward. Test repeated predictions and stateful layers explicitly.

title: GNCore Observability
description: Instrument and diagnose services using actionable logs, metrics, traces and service objectives.

workflows.title: GNCore Sentry Instrument
workflows.description: Instrument an application with Sentry — detect the platform, install and initialize the SDK if needed, and wire up any signal — error monitoring, tracing/performance, logging, metrics, profiling, session replay, user feedback, cron check-ins, uptime monitors for the deployed app, and AI/LLM monitoring (agent runs, token cost, and conversations for...
workflows.procedure: Identify framework and Sentry SDK versions, instrument relevant error/performance boundaries and propagate useful context without personal data or secrets. Trigger a controlled local error and verify capture/redaction using an authorized test sink. Keep sample rates and overhead explicit.

workflows.title: GNCore Sentry Debug Issue
workflows.description: Debug and fix a Sentry issue — find it (by link, ID, or search), pull full context (stack trace, breadcrumbs, trace, logs), optionally run Seer root-cause / autofix, apply the code fix, and resolve it via a `Fixes PROJECT-NAME-12A` commit/PR.
workflows.procedure: Use a supplied or authorized issue's stack, release, breadcrumbs and frequency to form a reproducible hypothesis. Trace the failing path in the matching revision, propose a bounded fix and regression, and distinguish a prepared fix from evidence that the live issue stopped recurring.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Observability
workflows.description: Design and verify useful service logs, traces, metrics, and alert signals with bounded overhead.
workflows.procedure: Identify service entrypoints, external calls, background jobs, and meaningful failure boundaries. Reuse existing telemetry conventions, propagate correlation context, redact sensitive values, and bound label cardinality. Verify a representative success and failure path emits useful signals. Use Sentry-specific workflows only for Sentry projects; separate local verification from evidence from a connected production system.

workflows.title: Structured diagnostic events
workflows.description: Structured diagnostic events.
workflows.procedure: Emit stable event names, severity and correlation identifiers at meaningful boundaries. Redact credentials/personal payloads and bound field size/cardinality. Test the success and error event sequence using a local sink without making logs the source of truth for authorization.

workflows.title: Metrics and actionable alerts
workflows.description: Metrics and actionable alerts.
workflows.procedure: Choose counters, gauges and histograms from an operational question, with explicit units and bounded labels. Derive an alert from a user-impact condition, define an owner/runbook and test both trigger and recovery; do not alert on every individual request error.

workflows.title: Trace propagation
workflows.description: Trace propagation.
workflows.procedure: Propagate context across request, queue and background boundaries using the selected library's current APIs. Test parent/child relationships and failed dependency spans on a fixture. State sampling assumptions and do not record secret headers or full request bodies.

workflows.title: Evidence-led incident diagnosis
workflows.description: Evidence-led incident diagnosis.
workflows.procedure: Build a timeline from correlated logs, metrics and traces; separate observed facts from hypotheses. Identify the smallest confirming probe and bounded mitigation with a rollback path. Preserve evidence and distinguish telemetry gaps from evidence that a component is healthy.

title: GNCore Performance Engineering
description: Profile and optimize software using repeatable latency, throughput and memory measurements.

workflows.title: Python Performance
workflows.description: Profile Python hotspots and improve measured runtime or memory without changing semantics.
workflows.procedure: Measure a representative baseline before optimizing. Profile CPU and memory with available tools, identify the dominant hotspot, and optimize that path while preserving outputs and errors. Avoid clever micro-optimizations without evidence. Re-run the same workload and report hardware, input scale, and before/after measurements.

workflows.title: Comparable benchmark design
workflows.description: Comparable benchmark design.
workflows.procedure: Specify representative input, machine/runtime versions, warmup, repeats and measurement boundaries. Separate setup from the measured operation and retain raw timings, not just a best run. Compare equivalent outputs and report dispersion and measurement noise.

workflows.title: Memory and allocation diagnosis
workflows.description: Memory and allocation diagnosis.
workflows.procedure: Distinguish retained state, allocation rate and peak working set on the same workload. Identify the allocation/retention path before optimizing and verify object lifetime after the change. Report tool limitations and workload-dependent tradeoffs.

workflows.title: Tail latency and saturation
workflows.description: Tail latency and saturation.
workflows.procedure: Record load generation, concurrency, timeouts and latency percentiles, including failed requests. Ramp only an authorized local/staging target and identify the saturation knee. Avoid coordinated-omission or success-only summaries that hide slow/failed work.

workflows.title: Performance regression review
workflows.description: Performance regression review.
workflows.procedure: Reproduce baseline and candidate under matching conditions, check correctness first and compare distributions with a practical change threshold. Trace regressions to a measured path and retain the raw evidence; avoid brittle single-run timing assertions in unit tests.

title: GNCore Python
description: Build, profile, package and migrate Python applications and libraries with reproducible environments.

workflows.title: Python Library Engineering
workflows.description: Design maintainable Python packages with stable APIs, typing, packaging, and clear examples.
workflows.procedure: Inspect supported Python versions, packaging backend, and public imports. Keep public APIs small and backward-compatible unless a breaking change is requested. Use explicit types and focused modules, avoid import-time side effects, declare runtime dependencies accurately, and provide a minimal runnable example. Check wheel and source inclusion rules when packaging changes.

workflows.title: Python Packaging
workflows.description: Package a Python library with clear APIs, reproducible builds, supported versions, and clean installation behavior.
workflows.procedure: For packaging changes, inspect the build backend, supported interpreters, dependencies, resources and public entrypoints. Produce the sdist, build a wheel from that archive and inspect both inventories. Clean-install outside the source checkout and invoke imports/commands from unrelated working directories on the supported interpreter range. Honor existing release authorization and keep build/compatibility evidence distinct from publication; ordinary Python fixes need only checks relevant to their behavior.

quality_revision.reason: Verify source-archive completeness and scope packaging checks to packaging work.

workflows.title: Python Upgrade and Migration
workflows.description: Migrate Python code or dependencies in a controlled way with compatibility evidence and a rollback path.
workflows.procedure: Identify the source and target versions, supported users, deprecations, and dependency constraints. Search all call sites, update in small coherent steps, and preserve public behavior unless the request says otherwise. Verify on the supported version matrix where available and document breaking changes. Avoid broad dependency upgrades bundled into the migration.

title: GNCore Release Engineering
description: Prepare tested software releases, reproducible artifacts, migrations and approval-ready publication plans.

workflows.title: Release Readiness Review
workflows.description: Check a release candidate against explicit acceptance, compatibility, security, rollback, and communication gates.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the release scope, version, changelog, artifacts, compatibility matrix, known issues, and rollback plan. Verify required checks and distinguish passed from skipped. Check migrations and external dependencies for rollout sequencing. Do not publish or deploy without authorization. End with a go/no-go recommendation tied to evidence and unresolved risks.

workflows.title: Artifact integrity and promotion
workflows.description: Artifact integrity and promotion.
workflows.procedure: For each intended wheel/source/platform target, build from the accepted tree, inspect metadata/resources/entrypoints, record hashes and install outside the checkout. For Python distributions, verify the wheel built from the produced source archive. Promote the same verified bytes to authorized destinations; distinct platform artifacts may legitimately differ. Retain source/CI/artifact identity and report unavailable destination verification rather than implying publication.

quality_revision.reason: Qualify build-once per target and honor existing destination authorization.

title: GNCore Systems Programming
description: Build Rust, C/C++ and native components with explicit ownership, ABI and resource lifetimes.

workflows.title: Ownership and resource lifetime
workflows.description: Ownership and resource lifetime.
workflows.procedure: Map allocation, ownership transfer, borrowing and cleanup for each resource. Use RAII or language-native lifetime guarantees where possible; define cancellation/error cleanup and test repeated creation/destruction without leaks or use-after-free.

workflows.title: FFI and ABI boundaries
workflows.description: FFI and ABI boundaries.
workflows.procedure: Specify ABI, fixed-width types, layout/alignment, lengths, encoding, ownership and matching destruction on both sides. Enforce checkable null, handle, length, alignment and overflow contracts, and document caller obligations for pointer provenance, lifetime and readable extent that cannot be established by superficial pointer inspection. Translate errors without unwinding across an incompatible boundary; test caller-language cleanup, invalid handles and in-flight callback teardown.

quality_revision.reason: Replace ambiguous pointer validation with enforceable checks and lifetime obligations.

workflows.title: Integer and buffer boundaries
workflows.description: Integer and buffer boundaries.
workflows.procedure: State allowed numeric ranges and byte/element units. Check overflow before allocation/index arithmetic and validate buffer length before access. Exercise minimum/maximum values and malformed input with compiler/runtime checks enabled.

workflows.title: Native concurrency
workflows.description: Native concurrency.
workflows.procedure: Identify shared state, synchronization and the ownership of shutdown. Specify lock order and atomic memory-order requirements before choosing lock-free structures. Test cancellation, contention and race instrumentation where supported; explain the limits of stress tests.

title: GNCore Testing
description: Design and implement unit, integration, contract, end-to-end and performance verification.

workflows.title: Accessibility Audit
workflows.description: Inspect a user flow for keyboard, screen reader, visual, and cognitive accessibility barriers.
workflows.procedure: Walk the actual flow using semantic structure, keyboard only, visible focus, zoom/reflow, labels, errors, and relevant assistive technology when available. Record reproducible steps, affected users, and evidence. Prioritize barriers by impact and task completion. Map findings to applicable criteria only when checked; do not claim full conformance from a partial audit.

workflows.title: Performance Audit
workflows.description: Find and verify the largest performance bottlenecks before changing code or infrastructure.
workflows.procedure: Capture a baseline under stated hardware, data, and load conditions. Profile before optimizing and identify the critical path. Change one bottleneck at a time, preserve correctness, and compare repeated measurements. Include tail latency and resource cost when relevant. Do not claim improvement without measured before/after evidence or scale workload beyond safe limits.

workflows.title: Test Strategy
workflows.description: Choose a balanced test plan that catches important failures at the lowest practical level.
workflows.procedure: Map changed behavior to risks and contracts. Prefer focused unit tests for logic, integration tests for boundaries, and a small number of end-to-end tests for critical journeys. Include failure paths, permissions, and data invariants. Avoid brittle implementation assertions and duplicated coverage. Report what is covered, what is unverified, and the exact commands run.

workflows.title: Requirements to Acceptance Tests
workflows.description: Turn requirements into observable acceptance cases that cover success, failure, boundaries, and permissions.
workflows.procedure: Extract actors, preconditions, inputs, expected outcomes, and constraints. Rewrite vague statements as observable behaviors and identify contradictions or missing decisions. Cover normal, boundary, error, permission, and recovery paths. Link cases to requirement IDs where available. Do not treat implementation details as acceptance criteria unless they are contractual.

workflows.title: Test Strategy
workflows.description: Choose a risk-based test mix that verifies behavior at the lowest effective level.
workflows.procedure: Map changed contracts and failure costs to unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, and performance checks. Prioritize boundary and recovery cases; report untested risk without padding coverage metrics.

workflows.title: Test Case Design
workflows.description: Turn a behavior contract into clear positive, negative, boundary, and state-transition tests.
workflows.procedure: Define preconditions, inputs, observable outcome, oracle, cleanup, and traceability. Use equivalence classes and realistic edge cases; avoid asserting incidental implementation details.

workflows.title: Test Automation
workflows.description: Build maintainable test automation with stable setup, deterministic data, and actionable failures.
workflows.procedure: Use isolated fixtures, explicit waits, stable selectors, safe cleanup, and failure artifacts that exclude secrets. Eliminate flaky timing and rerun failures to distinguish product defects from harness defects.

workflows.title: End-to-End User Journey Test
workflows.description: Verify a critical user journey across the application with realistic but isolated data.
workflows.procedure: Select the highest-value journey, define checkpoints, seed deterministic state, test success and a meaningful failure path, and clean up. Avoid production accounts and fixed sleeps.

workflows.title: API Contract Testing
workflows.description: Check API compatibility, validation, authorization, and error contracts between services.
workflows.procedure: Use versioned schemas and representative consumers, test malformed and unauthorized requests, verify status and error bodies, and detect breaking changes before deployment.

workflows.title: Performance Test Plan
workflows.description: Measure a service against representative load, latency, throughput, and resource objectives.
workflows.procedure: Set workload model, environment, warmup, duration, concurrency, percentiles, and safety limits. Compare repeatable baselines and stop before shared systems are harmed.

workflows.title: Accessibility Test Pass
workflows.description: Test a flow for keyboard operation, semantics, focus, labels, zoom, and assistive technology support.
workflows.procedure: Run automated checks and manual keyboard review, inspect focus and error announcements, test reflow/zoom, and record reproducible barriers. Do not claim full conformance from partial coverage.

workflows.title: Defect Triage
workflows.description: Classify and prioritize a defect using reproducibility, user impact, scope, and workaround evidence.
workflows.procedure: Capture environment, version, steps, expected and actual result, affected users, frequency, and evidence. Separate severity from priority and avoid unsupported root-cause claims.

workflows.title: Release Quality Gate
workflows.description: Evaluate release evidence against agreed quality gates and make residual risk visible.
workflows.procedure: Check required automated and manual evidence, unresolved defects, platform coverage, rollback, and known issues. Mark each gate passed, failed, skipped, or blocked; never equate a green pipeline with zero risk.

workflows.title: Flaky Test Investigation
workflows.description: Find the cause of an intermittent test failure and confirm a stable correction.
workflows.procedure: Collect repeated-run evidence, timestamps, ordering, shared state, network and timing dependencies. Reproduce under controlled conditions, fix the cause rather than suppressing the assertion, and demonstrate stable reruns.

workflows.title: Unit Testing
workflows.description: Write fast, deterministic unit tests around public behavior and edge cases.
workflows.procedure: Identify the contract and boundaries of one unit. Test normal, boundary, invalid, and regression cases with clear arrange/act/assert structure. Mock only external boundaries, not the behavior under test. Keep tests deterministic and assert meaningful outputs or side effects; never loosen assertions to silence a failure.

workflows.title: Integration Testing
workflows.description: Verify interactions between real components while isolating external services and state.
workflows.procedure: Choose the smallest integration path that crosses the relevant boundary. Use isolated temporary state or disposable fixtures, cover failure and cleanup behavior, and keep credentials and production endpoints out of tests. Distinguish environment failures from product failures in the report.

workflows.title: End-to-End Testing
workflows.description: Validate critical user journeys across the running application with stable, accessible assertions.
workflows.procedure: Select journeys by user impact and risk. Assert user-visible outcomes and accessibility semantics, use unique test data and deterministic setup, and clean up created state. Prefer waiting on a real condition over fixed sleeps. Report browser, environment, and skipped coverage accurately.

workflows.title: Test Automation Engineering
workflows.description: Create maintainable CI test workflows with clear triggers, artifacts, and failure signals.
workflows.procedure: Inspect existing CI conventions and execution limits. Run the fastest useful checks early, parallelize only independent jobs, cache only safe reproducible artifacts, and preserve failure output. Do not make a check advisory or suppress errors merely to get a green pipeline.

workflows.title: Performance and Load Testing
workflows.description: Design controlled load tests that measure latency, throughput, and saturation safely.
workflows.procedure: Define workload, concurrency, duration, target environment, and success thresholds before running. Use a staging or explicitly approved target and ramp traffic gradually. Capture percentiles, errors, resource saturation, and test conditions. Do not stress production or claim capacity from an uncontrolled run.

title: GNCore Web Backend
description: Implement backend services, APIs, integrations and framework features with explicit contracts and failure behavior.

workflows.title: GNCore Patterns
workflows.description: Backend architecture patterns, API design, database optimization, and server-side best practices for Node.js, Express, and Next.js API routes.
workflows.procedure: Trace request, application/domain and persistence boundaries in the existing service. Keep business invariants independent of transport details, make failure ownership explicit and introduce a new layer only when it simplifies a real change. Verify one complete success and failure path through the chosen boundaries.

workflows.title: GNCore Api Design
workflows.description: REST API design patterns including resource naming, status codes, pagination, filtering, error responses, versioning, and rate limiting for production APIs.
workflows.procedure: Specify resources, schemas, status/error codes, authorization, pagination and retry semantics from the consumer's task. Test invalid input, missing/forbidden resources and compatibility with current clients; do not let framework serialization defaults silently define a public contract.

workflows.title: GNCore Hexagonal Architecture
workflows.description: Design, implement, and refactor Ports & Adapters systems with clear domain boundaries, dependency inversion, and testable use-case orchestration across TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, and Go services.
workflows.procedure: Identify domain invariants and external dependencies, then define narrow ports around the dependencies that need substitution. Keep framework/ORM types in adapters, test the domain through ports and one real adapter integration, and avoid wrapping every internal function in an interface.

workflows.title: GNCore Error Handling
workflows.description: Patterns for robust error handling across TypeScript, Python, and Go.
workflows.procedure: Classify validation, authorization, conflict, transient dependency and unexpected errors. Preserve diagnostic causes internally while returning stable public errors without secrets. Test exception-to-response mapping, transaction rollback and whether a retry can duplicate the side effect.

workflows.title: GNCore Contract First
workflows.description: Coordinate frontend/backend or service-to-service work through one authoritative machine-checkable contract (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protocol Buffers, or JSON Schema), with generated consumer types and contract-verified integration.
workflows.procedure: Write request/response and error examples before implementation, including absence, invalid values and authorization. Validate the schema and consumer expectations against existing versions, then implement and run contract tests so documentation and runtime behavior agree.

workflows.title: GNCore Api Connector Builder
workflows.description: Build a new API connector or provider by matching the target repo's existing integration pattern exactly.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the external API's authentication, pagination, rate limits and versioned schema. Implement a typed boundary with bounded retries only for safe operations, timeouts and redacted diagnostics. Replay recorded/synthetic success, malformed response, pagination and quota/error fixtures before a live call.

workflows.title: GNCore Spec To Code Compliance
workflows.description: Check code against the documentation that specifies it - which requirements hold, which the code contradicts, which are absent, and what the code does that no document mentions.
workflows.procedure: Turn supplied normative requirements into traceable code paths and executable acceptance cases. Distinguish MUST behavior from optional guidance and missing specification. Report each mismatch with source location and observed behavior instead of treating a passing schema check as full compliance.

workflows.title: GNCore Supabase Postgres Best Practices
workflows.description: Postgres best practices maintained by Supabase, for Postgres running anywhere.
workflows.procedure: Inspect Postgres access patterns and Supabase role/RLS boundaries. Parameterize queries, encode integrity in constraints and inspect plans before indexing. Verify authenticated and cross-tenant negative cases using the actual role model; a privileged service key must not stand in for user-policy testing.

workflows.title: GNCore Postgres Patterns
workflows.description: PostgreSQL database patterns for query optimization, schema design, indexing, and security.
workflows.procedure: Choose transaction isolation, constraints and indexes from the invariant and workload. Reproduce null/uniqueness behavior, lock conflicts and the query plan in a local Postgres fixture. Keep connection lifetime and prepared-query behavior consistent with the selected driver/pool.

workflows.title: GNCore Database Migrations
workflows.description: Safe, reversible database migration patterns: forward-only production changes, expand-contract zero-downtime renames, concurrent indexes, batched backfills, and per-tool workflows for PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle, Kysely, Django, and golang-migrate.
workflows.procedure: Use expand/backfill/validate/contract sequencing for mixed-version deployments. Make backfills bounded and restartable, state the policy for unknown values and rehearse lock/failure behavior. Separate a reversible schema change from data changes that cannot be automatically undone.

workflows.title: GNCore Benchmark
workflows.description: Measure performance baselines and detect regressions across browser Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS, page weight), API endpoint latency percentiles, and build/test feedback times, with before/after comparison stored in git-tracked .ecc/benchmarks JSON.
workflows.procedure: Define workload, environment, warmup, concurrency and success thresholds before measuring. Retain raw latency/error/throughput results and compare identical request/data conditions. Separate benchmark setup cost from the measured operation and avoid claiming production capacity from a local microbenchmark.

workflows.title: GNCore Benchmark Optimization Loop
workflows.description: Convert 'make it faster' requests into a bounded measured optimization loop — baseline first, generate one-hypothesis variants, benchmark each against a correctness gate, and promote the fastest safe variant with reproducible commands.
workflows.procedure: Capture a reproducible baseline, profile the dominant cost, make one targeted change and compare both correctness and distributions on the same workload. Keep raw evidence and stop if improvement is within noise or a correctness/resource tradeoff is unacceptable.

workflows.title: GNCore Latency Critical Systems
workflows.description: Optimize and verify latency-sensitive systems — realtime dashboards, market data feeds, streaming agents, execution gateways, queues, and caches — by tracking p50/p95/p99 latency, freshness age, and queue depth, mapping hot paths, and running live readbacks.
workflows.procedure: Allocate an end-to-end latency budget and measure dependency, queue and serialization contributions, including tails and errors. Bound queues, deadlines and cancellation; test overload/recovery rather than optimizing only successful warm requests. Explain the conditions under which the target was measured.

workflows.title: GNCore Redis Patterns
workflows.description: Redis data structure patterns, caching strategies, distributed locks, rate limiting, pub/sub, and connection management for production applications.
workflows.procedure: Choose Redis key structure, TTL, invalidation and atomicity from the cache/state contract. Define cache-miss and unavailable-cache behavior and test stale data, expiry, concurrent updates and hot-key effects. Do not turn a disposable cache into an undocumented source of truth.

workflows.title: GNCore Deployment Patterns
workflows.description: Deployment workflows, CI/CD pipeline patterns, Docker containerization, health checks, rollback strategies, and production readiness checklists for web applications.
workflows.procedure: Prepare a staged rollout with version compatibility, meaningful health signals and rollback criteria. Validate configuration and migration order in a safe environment; keep code preparation, deployment execution and verified live traffic separate in the report.

workflows.title: GNCore Docker
workflows.description: Docker and Docker Compose patterns for local development, hardened CLI installer harnesses, container security, networking, volumes, and multi-service orchestration.
workflows.procedure: Use the repository's supported base/runtime images, a minimal build context and a non-secret runtime configuration. Check multi-stage output, user/file permissions, health/startup/shutdown and resource limits. Build and run the image locally before claiming container readiness.

workflows.title: GNCore Github Ops
workflows.description: GitHub repository operations, automation, and management.
workflows.procedure: Inspect workflow triggers, permissions, dependency/cache boundaries and required checks. Restrict credentials to the job that needs them and preserve actionable failure artifacts. Exercise the workflow commands locally and report remote CI separately; do not change branch rules or publish artifacts without scope authorization.

workflows.title: GNCore Production Audit
workflows.description: Local-evidence production readiness audit for shipped apps, pre-launch reviews, post-merge checks, and "what breaks in prod?" questions without sending repo data to an external audit service.
workflows.procedure: Review an explicitly scoped service's configuration, dependency boundaries, resource/timeout controls, observability and recovery evidence. Link findings to reachable code/configuration and impact. Use read-only/local checks unless production access/actions are authorized; do not certify readiness from a checklist alone.

workflows.title: GNCore Agentic Engineering
workflows.description: Operate as an agentic engineer using eval-first execution, decomposition, and cost-aware model routing.
workflows.procedure: Define the agent's task, allowed tools, state transitions and bounded execution budget. Validate tool arguments/results and isolate side effects from model suggestions. Test tool failure, hostile retrieved instructions, retry and budget exhaustion with fixtures before introducing live integrations.

workflows.title: GNCore Mcp Server Patterns
workflows.description: Build MCP servers with Node/TypeScript SDK — tools, resources, prompts, Zod validation, stdio vs Streamable HTTP.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the selected MCP protocol/SDK version and model resources, tools and prompts with explicit schemas and authorization. Keep transport/session lifecycle separate from domain behavior. Test invalid tool inputs, canceled requests and reconnect/cleanup paths with an available protocol client.

workflows.title: GNCore Agent Eval
workflows.description: Head-to-head comparison of coding agents (Claude Code, Aider, Codex, etc.) on custom tasks with pass rate, cost, time, and consistency metrics.
workflows.procedure: Build representative task and failure cases, define objective success and human-review rubrics, and record model/tool/configuration versions. Compare changes on the same cases and separate structure/trace validity from semantic task success. Mark unrun provider or subjective evaluations honestly.

workflows.title: GNCore Cost Aware Llm Pipeline
workflows.description: Cost optimization patterns for LLM API usage — model routing by task complexity, budget tracking, retry logic, and prompt caching.
workflows.procedure: Record per-request token/tool budgets, latency requirements and acceptable fallback behavior. Cache only with correct identity/freshness boundaries and route simpler work to appropriate models without weakening output validation. Measure actual provider usage when authorized; otherwise use explicit cost assumptions.

workflows.title: GNCore Mcp Builder
workflows.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools.
workflows.procedure: Start from the consumer operation, define small typed MCP tools and useful errors, and implement the selected SDK's lifecycle correctly. Verify schemas, authentication/authority propagation and a real local client round-trip. Publishing a server or exposing credentials is a separate authorized action.

workflows.title: GNCore Agents Sdk
workflows.description: Build, debug, or review Cloudflare Agents SDK applications using the agents package.
workflows.procedure: Confirm which Agents SDK and runtime the project actually uses. Implement explicit state/tool contracts, bounded orchestration and error handling with that version's APIs. Test deterministic tool boundaries and resume/cancellation before enabling hosted models or persistent external state.

workflows.title: GNCore Building Ai Agent On Cloudflare
workflows.description: Build a scoped AI agent on Cloudflare with explicit state, tool boundaries, bindings, and evaluation cases.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the selected Workers and Agents SDK versions, Wrangler configuration, bindings, authentication, state storage, and model provider. Implement the requested agent interaction with typed tool inputs, bounded retries, cancellation, and durable state only where needed. Keep provider credentials in the platform secret mechanism. Verify a useful task, a tool error, and an unauthorized request locally; prepare deployment instructions without claiming a deployed service unless deployment was requested and verified.

workflows.title: GNCore Fastapi
workflows.description: Build FastAPI endpoints, Pydantic models, dependencies, and streaming responses using version-compatible APIs.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed fastapi version and existing application conventions, especially typed request/response models, dependency overrides, generated OpenAPI and async I/O boundaries. Implement a complete scoped feature in the existing application without introducing an unrelated framework migration.

workflows.title: GNCore Fastapi Patterns
workflows.description: FastAPI best practices covering project structure, Pydantic v2 schemas, dependency injection, async handlers, authentication, authorization, transactional service layers, and testing with httpx and pytest.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed fastapi version and existing application conventions, especially typed request/response models, dependency overrides, generated OpenAPI and async I/O boundaries. Apply the project's conventions to the requested feature, keeping transport, domain invariants and persistence responsibilities clear.

workflows.title: GNCore Django
workflows.description: Django architecture patterns, REST API design with DRF, ORM best practices, caching, signals, middleware, and production-grade Django apps.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed django version and existing application conventions, especially ORM constraints/transactions, migrations, queryset ownership, middleware and server-side permissions. Implement a complete scoped feature in the existing application without introducing an unrelated framework migration.

workflows.title: GNCore Django Security
workflows.description: Django security best practices, authentication, authorization, CSRF protection, SQL injection prevention, XSS prevention, and secure deployment configurations.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed django version and existing application conventions, especially ORM constraints/transactions, migrations, queryset ownership, middleware and server-side permissions. Trace request identity and ownership through policy/guard checks, test cross-user access and inspect sensitive logging and configuration.

workflows.title: GNCore Django Tdd
workflows.description: Django testing strategies with pytest-django, TDD methodology, factory_boy, mocking, coverage, and testing Django REST Framework APIs.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed django version and existing application conventions, especially ORM constraints/transactions, migrations, queryset ownership, middleware and server-side permissions. Write an observable failing request/domain regression, implement the smallest correct path and then refactor with integration evidence.

workflows.title: GNCore Django Verification
workflows.description: Run the full Django verification loop — environment check, mypy/ruff/black linting, migration safety, pytest with coverage targets, pip-audit and bandit security scans, settings and logging review, and diff review — producing a phased pass/fail report before release or PR.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed django version and existing application conventions, especially ORM constraints/transactions, migrations, queryset ownership, middleware and server-side permissions. Run relevant tests, configuration/build checks and a local request round-trip; distinguish the prepared change from a deployed service.

workflows.title: GNCore Nestjs Patterns
workflows.description: NestJS architecture patterns for modules, controllers, providers, DTO validation, guards, interceptors, config, and production-grade TypeScript backends.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed nestjs version and existing application conventions, especially module/provider boundaries, validated DTOs, guards, exception filters and application lifecycle. Apply the project's conventions to the requested feature, keeping transport, domain invariants and persistence responsibilities clear.

workflows.title: GNCore Springboot Patterns
workflows.description: Spring Boot architecture patterns, REST API design, layered services, data access, caching, async processing, and logging.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed springboot version and existing application conventions, especially service/transaction boundaries, validated request DTOs, security filters and persistence integration. Apply the project's conventions to the requested feature, keeping transport, domain invariants and persistence responsibilities clear.

workflows.title: GNCore Springboot Security
workflows.description: Spring Security best practices for authn/authz, validation, CSRF, secrets, headers, rate limiting, and dependency security in Java Spring Boot services.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed springboot version and existing application conventions, especially service/transaction boundaries, validated request DTOs, security filters and persistence integration. Trace request identity and ownership through policy/guard checks, test cross-user access and inspect sensitive logging and configuration.

workflows.title: GNCore Springboot Tdd
workflows.description: Test-driven development for Spring Boot using JUnit 5, Mockito, MockMvc, Testcontainers, and JaCoCo.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed springboot version and existing application conventions, especially service/transaction boundaries, validated request DTOs, security filters and persistence integration. Write an observable failing request/domain regression, implement the smallest correct path and then refactor with integration evidence.

workflows.title: GNCore Springboot Verification
workflows.description: Run the full Spring Boot verification loop — Maven or Gradle build, SpotBugs, PMD, and Checkstyle static analysis, unit and Testcontainers integration tests with JaCoCo coverage, OWASP dependency and secret scans, and diff review — producing a pass/fail readiness report.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed springboot version and existing application conventions, especially service/transaction boundaries, validated request DTOs, security filters and persistence integration. Run relevant tests, configuration/build checks and a local request round-trip; distinguish the prepared change from a deployed service.

workflows.title: GNCore Golang Patterns
workflows.description: Idiomatic Go patterns, best practices, and conventions for building robust, efficient, and maintainable Go applications.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed golang version and existing application conventions, especially context cancellation, error wrapping, goroutine lifetime, race checks and HTTP/database timeouts. Apply the project's conventions to the requested feature, keeping transport, domain invariants and persistence responsibilities clear.

workflows.title: GNCore Golang Testing
workflows.description: Go testing patterns including table-driven tests, subtests, benchmarks, fuzzing, and test coverage.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed golang version and existing application conventions, especially context cancellation, error wrapping, goroutine lifetime, race checks and HTTP/database timeouts. workflows.title: GNCore Backend Workflow
workflows.description: Route a backend task to the appropriate architecture, API, database, stack, security, or operations workflow.

Select only the matching stack and the specialist skills needed for the request. Implement the scoped service behavior and verify its success, failure, and permission paths. Use existing infrastructure and interfaces unless the user requests a change.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Code Quality
workflows.description: Improve backend correctness and maintainability across boundaries, data handling, concurrency, and error paths.
workflows.procedure: Inspect a representative request or job path before refactoring. Check validation at boundaries, authorization at sensitive operations, ownership of transactions and state, cancellation and timeout behavior, and error propagation. Prefer clear interfaces and explicit invariants over generic abstraction layers. Make a focused improvement and verify relevant observable behavior; use the code quality, review, contract, or stack workflow that addresses the actual problem.

workflows.title: GNCore Backend Security
