Check object-level authorization, injection-safe queries, output handling, session and CSRF controls where relevant, and redacted failures. Reproduce concrete issues locally and verify allowed and denied cases after fixing them. Distinguish a scoped review from a claim that the whole service is secure.

workflows.title: Web Development
workflows.description: Plan and implement a focused web feature using the repository's existing framework, patterns, and tests.
workflows.procedure: Help implement the web development task the user describes. First inspect the existing app and identify the smallest relevant change. Follow its framework, architecture, accessibility, and security conventions. State assumptions when they affect the result. Change only files needed for the requested feature; do not rewrite unrelated pages, architecture, dependencies, or configuration. Ask before broad migrations or destructive changes. Summarize changed files and any checks performed.

workflows.title: SEO Audit
workflows.description: Improve technical and content discoverability using crawlable structure and verifiable search metadata.
workflows.procedure: Inspect rendered HTML, indexability, canonical URLs, structured data, sitemap, redirects, and page performance. Fix concrete issues in the existing framework and preserve user-facing meaning. Validate structured data syntax and avoid keyword stuffing or fabricated claims. Search rankings cannot be guaranteed; distinguish technical checks from outcome estimates.

title: GNCore Web Frontend
description: Build complete responsive web interfaces and choose an appropriate visual direction from the product brief.

workflows.title: GNCore Design
workflows.description: Build or restyle a web interface with a deliberate visual identity and complete interaction states.
workflows.procedure: Ground the visual direction in the actual product and audience. Establish typography, layout, palette, and a primary action before implementing the requested page. Use real content and inspect the finished interface in a browser.

workflows.title: GNCore Ui Ux
workflows.description: Choose evidence-based UI patterns, palettes, typography, and layouts using a searchable local design library.
workflows.procedure: Use the bundled search script and data to compare patterns appropriate to the product. Check accessibility and task flow before aesthetic polish. Record the selected direction and implement it in the current framework.

workflows.title: GNCore React
workflows.description: Improve React and Next.js rendering, data fetching, and bundle performance using measured bottlenecks.
workflows.procedure: Inspect framework versions and a baseline. Read the relevant async, bundle, server, or rendering rules rather than loading every rule. Preserve request isolation and verify that any optimization changes measured behavior without changing correctness.

workflows.title: GNCore Guidelines
workflows.description: Review a web interface against current interface guidelines and report actionable file and line findings.
workflows.procedure: Fetch the guideline source identified in UPSTREAM.md and review the requested files. Tie findings to actual code and user impact. If the source is unavailable, state that limitation and distinguish local checks from a current guideline audit.

workflows.title: GNCore Shadcn
workflows.description: Add and customize shadcn/ui components within an existing React application and theme.
workflows.procedure: Inspect components.json, framework, aliases, installed primitives, and Tailwind version. Choose compatible registry components, preserve local customizations, and verify controlled state, keyboard interactions, focus restoration, and theme tokens.

workflows.title: GNCore Minimalism
workflows.description: Create restrained web interfaces with clear hierarchy, deliberate whitespace, and essential controls.
workflows.procedure: Reduce competing emphasis rather than hiding necessary actions. Use a compact type scale, a neutral surface system, and one purposeful accent. Align content to a consistent grid; give primary and secondary actions distinct weight. Preserve explicit loading, empty, error, and success states. Check long labels, zoom, keyboard focus, and narrow screens.

workflows.title: GNCore Swiss
workflows.description: Build Swiss and International Style web layouts using typographic hierarchy and disciplined grids.
workflows.procedure: Define column and baseline relationships, a legible grotesk type hierarchy, and deliberate asymmetric composition. Use alignment and scale to organize content. Keep reading order and interaction order coherent when the grid collapses on small screens.

workflows.title: GNCore Editorial
workflows.description: Design magazine and editorial web experiences with strong reading rhythm, type, and image relationships.
workflows.procedure: Choose a readable text measure, display hierarchy, captions, and image proportions around the actual story. Build responsive article and index layouts with intentional pacing and clear navigation.

workflows.title: GNCore Luxury
workflows.description: Create premium web experiences through typography, art direction, restrained detail, and polished interaction.
workflows.procedure: Choose a distinct material or editorial direction appropriate to the brand. Use deliberate type contrast, image cropping, restrained color, and consistent spacing rather than adding decoration to every surface. Keep prices, navigation, and purchase actions easy to find. Budget image weight and motion; verify mobile composition and reduced-motion behavior. Use licensed imagery and avoid invented customer or award claims.

workflows.title: GNCore Agentic
workflows.description: Design AI task interfaces that expose progress, editable intent, results, and recovery controls.
workflows.procedure: Make the task goal, inputs, running state, and result visible. Separate proposals from completed actions, show meaningful progress and recoverable errors, and provide cancel or edit controls where supported. Avoid implying actions succeeded without tool evidence.

workflows.title: GNCore Maximalism
workflows.description: Build expressive maximalist web interfaces with rich layers and a readable visual hierarchy.
workflows.procedure: Choose a coherent motif, palette, and focal point for each section. Use layering, oversized type, and texture to reinforce content; preserve legible body text and predictable navigation across screen sizes.

workflows.title: GNCore Taste
workflows.description: Art-direct a distinctive frontend using researched compositions and iterative browser inspection.
workflows.procedure: Use the bundled direction library and references to select a product-specific composition. Inspect helper scripts before running them and resolve their paths from the installed skill folder. Iterate on observed screenshots without replacing the user's chosen design system.

workflows.title: GNCore Neobrutalism
workflows.description: Create neo-brutalist web UI with bold borders, flat color, and direct, usable controls.
workflows.procedure: Define border, shadow, spacing, and type tokens. Use offset shadows and strong block geometry consistently, preserving distinguishable focus, disabled, and error states without using color as the only signal.

workflows.title: GNCore Industrial
workflows.description: Build industrial brutalist web interfaces with structural grids, utility typography, and exposed function.
workflows.procedure: Choose a functional visual vocabulary: squared geometry, ruled divisions, strong labels, restrained material tones, and numerals suited to scanning. Use density according to the task and collapse secondary detail on narrow screens without losing access. Distinguish interactive controls from decorative hardware motifs. Check contrast, focus, overflow, and long technical values; avoid distressed textures behind body text.

workflows.title: GNCore Futuristic
workflows.description: Create futuristic and Y2K-inspired interfaces with deliberate technical typography and spatial depth.
workflows.procedure: Pick a specific visual era and use its geometry, display type, metallic or luminous surfaces, and motion consistently. Keep ordinary text, controls, and responsive navigation readable beneath the effects.

workflows.title: GNCore Retro
workflows.description: Create nostalgic web interfaces with era-specific typography, palettes, and graphic treatments.
workflows.procedure: Choose an era and build a coherent type, color, and illustration system around it. Keep semantic controls and modern interaction feedback; do not reproduce obsolete usability problems as decoration.

workflows.title: GNCore Collage
workflows.description: Build paper and scrapbook web compositions with tactile layers and coherent reading order.
workflows.procedure: Use paper surfaces, cutout imagery, and controlled overlap with a clear content hierarchy. Keep labels selectable, text contrast stable, and decorative layers outside pointer and keyboard interaction paths.

workflows.title: GNCore Doodle
workflows.description: Create playful hand-drawn web interfaces with readable type and controlled visual irregularity.
workflows.procedure: Use sketch marks and imperfect outlines as accents around a stable layout. Keep body typography readable and ensure handmade-looking controls retain clear labels, hit areas, focus states, and disabled behavior.

workflows.title: GNCore Bento
workflows.description: Organize web content in a responsive bento grid with purposeful card sizes and hierarchy.
workflows.procedure: Rank content before choosing spans. Use card sizes to reflect importance, preserve useful reading order when stacked, and avoid fixed heights that clip translated text or changing data.

workflows.title: GNCore Glass
workflows.description: Build glass and translucent web surfaces with readable contrast and affordable rendering costs.
workflows.procedure: Use translucency sparingly over controlled backgrounds. Define opaque fallbacks, borders, and focus treatments. Test changing imagery, light and dark themes, blur support, reduced transparency where available, and performance on constrained devices.

workflows.title: GNCore Neumorphism
workflows.description: Create soft inset and raised web surfaces while keeping control states accessible.
workflows.procedure: Use paired highlights and shadows on restrained surfaces. Add borders, labels, and explicit focus indicators so controls do not depend on subtle shadows to communicate affordance or state.

workflows.title: GNCore Claymorphism
workflows.description: Create playful clay-like web surfaces with rounded geometry and tactile depth.
workflows.procedure: Define a restrained radius and shadow system, use dimensional accents for emphasis, and keep content surfaces calm. Check legibility, visual weight, and interaction state differences at small sizes.

workflows.title: GNCore Aurora
workflows.description: Create aurora and gradient web treatments with controlled color transitions and readable content.
workflows.procedure: Choose gradient stops from the product palette and define a stable text-bearing surface. Check contrast across every stop and fallback; keep animated gradients optional and measure their rendering cost.

workflows.title: GNCore Cyberpunk
workflows.description: Build neon and cyberpunk web interfaces with disciplined glow, dark surfaces, and clear interaction states.
workflows.procedure: Use luminous accents to guide attention rather than outline every element. Keep body text sharp, avoid flashing effects, and distinguish focus, errors, and active controls beyond hue alone.

workflows.title: GNCore Threejs
workflows.description: Implement immersive Three.js and WebGL web experiences with explicit asset and rendering budgets.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the existing renderer and dependencies. Budget draw calls, texture sizes, device pixel ratio, and asset loading; handle resize, context loss, disposal, and an accessible non-WebGL fallback.

workflows.title: GNCore R3F
workflows.description: Build React Three Fiber scenes with clear React and render-loop ownership and proper cleanup.
workflows.procedure: Keep React state changes outside high-frequency frame work where possible. Reuse resources, dispose owned geometry and materials, suspend expensive assets deliberately, and test loading, fallback, and reduced-motion states.

workflows.title: GNCore Scrollytelling
workflows.description: Build scroll-driven narratives with GSAP ScrollTrigger and resilient responsive behavior.
workflows.procedure: Map the narrative to ordinary document flow before pinning or scrubbing. Register plugins, scope animation ownership, refresh after layout changes, and clean up on navigation. Preserve content access and a reduced-motion experience.

workflows.title: GNCore Kinetic Type
workflows.description: Animate web typography with purposeful timing while preserving readable text and reduced-motion access.
workflows.procedure: Keep semantic text available to assistive technology when splitting visible glyphs. Handle font loading, line wrapping, interruption, and reduced motion. Review timing with real copy and preserve content access when animation is disabled.

workflows.title: GNCore Organic
workflows.description: Create warm organic web interfaces using earth tones, natural rhythm, and tactile accents.
workflows.procedure: Use a product-appropriate natural palette and readable type hierarchy, preserving explicit brand colors. Warm neutrals or earth tones are options, not a mandatory terracotta accent. Let natural shapes support content without obscuring text, hit areas or predictable navigation.

quality_revision.reason: Remove a fixed palette that overrides brand constraints.

workflows.title: GNCore Design System
workflows.description: Define web design tokens, component contracts, and state specifications that fit an existing product.
workflows.procedure: Map primitive tokens to semantic roles and component tokens. Specify themes, typography, spacing, interaction states, and migration from existing values. Use the web design references; load slide-related material only for an explicit presentation task.

workflows.title: GNCore Styling
workflows.description: Style responsive web components using Tailwind, semantic tokens, and accessible primitives.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the installed styling versions and reuse the current token and component system. Compose consistent variants and responsive behavior. Validate dark mode, focus, loading, validation, and long content without importing unrelated canvas workflows.

workflows.title: GNCore Composition
workflows.description: Refactor React component APIs using composition, clear state ownership, and version-compatible context patterns.
workflows.procedure: Identify the concrete source of prop proliferation or duplicated state. Read the relevant composition rules and use explicit variants or compound components only where they improve the caller API. Preserve behavior and confirm the project's React version.

workflows.title: GNCore Gsap
workflows.description: Implement GSAP tweens and responsive animation with explicit lifecycle and interruption handling.
workflows.procedure: Use the installed GSAP version and scope animation ownership to the component or page. Choose tweens, timelines, and matchMedia according to the requested effect. Clean up on unmount, respect reduced motion, and preserve a library the user already chose.

workflows.title: GNCore Motion Performance
workflows.description: Profile and improve animation rendering cost without changing intended behavior.
workflows.procedure: Capture a representative animation trace before optimizing. Identify layout, paint, compositing, or JavaScript costs; reduce the dominant cost and compare under the same conditions. Budget promoted layers and avoid claiming a frame rate without measurements.

workflows.title: GNCore Motion Review
workflows.description: Review web animation timing, easing, continuity, and interaction feedback with actionable findings.
workflows.procedure: Observe the actual interaction and relevant implementation. Check purpose, interruption, entry and exit, perceived response, and reduced motion. Report concrete changes tied to the observed sequence and distinguish measured behavior from design judgment.

workflows.title: GNCore Testing
workflows.description: Test important local web user journeys with Playwright and observable browser evidence.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the app's existing test setup and start it using the supported command. Cover the requested journey with role/name selectors, deterministic fixtures, and observable assertions. Capture failures and rerun relevant checks after fixing causes.

workflows.title: GNCore Browser

workflows.procedure: Check whether agent-browser is available and use its documented snapshot and reference workflow. Work within the requested browser session and task. Verify the resulting UI state and report screenshots or commands as evidence; do not infer success from an attempted click.

workflows.title: GNCore Find Skills
workflows.description: Find frontend skills and compare candidates by scope, source, compatibility, and license.
workflows.procedure: Inspect the product, existing stack, requested deliverable and available workflow map. Choose the smallest useful set: usually one visual direction and the engineering/testing workflow the task needs. Read the selected section in WORKFLOWS.md and its relevant attributed reference. These entries are workflows in this skill, not separate installed SKILL.md files. Implement the requested feature and verify its observable result without loading every style or changing the chosen stack.

quality_revision.reason: Correct the router to point to actual exported workflow resources.

workflows.title: GNCore Responsive Accessibility
workflows.description: Implement and verify responsive, keyboard-accessible web interfaces and assistive-technology semantics.
workflows.procedure: Inspect semantic structure, labels, tab order, visible focus, dialog focus ownership, validation messages, zoom, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior. Test real user tasks at narrow and wide widths with long content. Apply relevant WCAG criteria when requested, and distinguish automated checks from manual or assistive-technology checks. Do not claim conformance without evidence.

workflows.procedure: Inspect the product, existing stack, requested deliverable, and available skill folders. Choose the smallest useful set from the catalog below: typically one visual direction and the engineering or testing workflow the task needs. Read those SKILL.md files and only their task-relevant references. Implement the complete requested feature and verify the observable result. Do not load every style or change the user's chosen stack.
